verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Sam was jailed for helping Hong Kong's protesters. He came home to a city in silence
title.zh: 香港镇压异见，山姆出狱后发现城市一片寂静

summary.en: Six years after China imposed the National Security Law, Hong Kong's crackdown on dissent has spread beyond its borders.
summary.zh: 中国实施《国家安全法》六年之后，香港对异见的镇压已蔓延至境外。

body.en:
Watch Dateline’s latest episode, Hong Kong: A City Silenced, on 25 August at 9.30pm AEST on SBS or SBS On Demand.

At 21, Sam Chan Chi-sum was preparing to leave Hong Kong to continue his studies overseas.

He'd been involved with a student activist group that collected sweets and toiletries to send to people jailed after Hong Kong’s 2019 anti-government protests.

Authorities accused the group of using the supplies to build support among prisoners and incite opposition to the government.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In September 2021, Sam was arrested under Hong Kong’s sweeping National Security Law, which had been passed a year earlier, and was convicted of "subversion with the intent of overthrowing the government".

"Prison was awful. I shared a cell with around twenty people. At its most crowded, there could be forty of us," he said.

He alleged some prison officers purposely mistreated inmates associated with the protest movement.

"I don't know whether they were acting out of personal conviction or following orders. But they certainly made life difficult for us."

Two years after his release from prison, Sam is trying to rebuild a normal life.

He had dreamt of becoming a teacher or a nurse, but his criminal record prevents him from pursuing either career.

"Since being released from prison, I feel as though I've entered a much larger cell," he said.

Instead, he is training to become a documentary filmmaker, determined, he says, to capture the transformation of Hong Kong.

"Whatever the outcome for Hong Kong, whether the future is good or bad, I want to stay here and witness the changes that lie ahead."

Sam’s story is like many other young Hongkongers whose lives have been upended by China’s crackdown on freedoms in Hong Kong, a city once known for its outspoken press, independent judiciary and political opposition.

In 1997, after more than 150 years of British rule, Hong Kong was handed back to China under the "one country, two systems" arrangement that promised Hong Kong would keep a high degree of autonomy.

Like Sam, Carmen Lau was from a generation that came of age after this handover to China: neither British, nor truly Chinese.

As a teenager, Carmen led a student movement in her secondary school against the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) attempt to introduce 'patriotism' lessons in Hong Kong schools.

Many Hongkongers feared it would promote the CCP’s version of patriotism in their city.

"That time was the first time that I was really involved in a social event," said Lau, who’s now 30 and lives in exile in London.

Following large demonstrations, the CCP abandoned its plans...
body.zh: 8 月 25 日晚上 9 点半（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 观看《Dateline》的最新一集《香港：一座沉默的城市》。 21岁的陈志森正准备离开香港到海外继续深造。 他曾参与一个学生活动团体，该团体收集糖果和洗漱用品，寄给香港 2019 年反政府抗议活动后入狱的人。 当局指责该组织利用这些物资在囚犯中赢得支持并煽动反对政府。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 2021年9月，Sam根据一年前通过的香港国家安全法被捕，并被判“颠覆国家政权罪”。 “监狱太糟糕了。我和大约二十个人同住一间牢房。最拥挤的时候，我们可能有四十个人，”他说。 他声称一些监狱官员故意虐待与抗议运动有关的囚犯。 “我不知道他们是出于个人信念还是奉命行事。但他们确实让我们的生活变得困难。” 出狱两年后，萨姆正在努力重建正常的生活。 他曾梦想成为一名教师或护士，但他的犯罪记录阻止了他从事这两种职业。 “自从出狱后，我感觉自己好像进入了一个更大的牢房，”他说。 相反，他正在接受培训，成为一名纪录片制片人，他说，决心捕捉香港的转变。 “无论香港的结果如何，无论未来是好还是坏，我都想留在这里，见证未来的变化。” 萨姆的故事就像许多其他香港年轻人一样，他们的生活因中国对香港自由的镇压而被打乱。这座城市曾经以其直言不讳的新闻界、独立的司法机构和政治反对派而闻名。 1997年，在英国统治150多年之后，香港在“一国两制”安排下回归中国，并承诺香港将保持高度自治。 和 Sam 一样，刘嘉敏也是中国回归后长大的一代人：既不是英国人，也不是真正的中国人。 青少年时期，卡门在中学领导了一场学生运动，反对中国共产党试图在香港学校引入“爱国主义”课程。 许多香港人担心这会在他们的城市宣扬中共版本的爱国主义。 “那次是我第一次真正参与社交活动，”现年 30 岁、流亡伦敦的刘说。 大规模示威后，中共放弃了计划……

reflection.en: The story of Sam returning to a silenced city after imprisonment highlights the profound impact of oppressive rule on a community. Yahweh's word reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a roaring lion, bringing fear and helplessness to the people. In such times, we are called to remember the dignity of every individual and pray for justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 山姆在被囚禁后回到一个寂静的城市，这个故事凸显了压迫性统治对一个社区的深远影响。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者如同咆哮的狮子，给人民带来恐惧和无助。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召要记住每个人的尊严，并为公义与和平祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Watch: Moment humanoid robot beats Usain Bolt's 100m record
title.zh: 见证时刻：人形机器人打破博尔特百米纪录

summary.en: A humanoid robot developed in Beijing has completed a 100m sprint in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's world record of 9.58 seconds. The event, held at the World Humanoid Robot Games, showcased advancements in robotics including boxing, football, and household tasks. While the robot's speed is a mechanical...
summary.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，一台人形机器人以9.39秒的成绩完成了百米冲刺，超越了尤塞恩·博尔特9.58秒的世界纪录。此次活动展示了机器人在拳击、足球和家务处理等领域的进步。虽然机器人的速度是一个机械里程碑，但它也凸显了在模仿人类体能方面飞速的技术进步。

body.en:
A robot has outperformed humans by running faster than Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record at the World Humanoid Robot Games in China.

The humanoid robot, developed by the Beijing Innovation Centre of Humanoid Robotics, ran the distance in 9.39 seconds at the event.

Eight-time Olympic gold medallist Bolt set the world record for humans in 2009, running 100m in 9.58 seconds.

The robot beat two others including one made by Chinese smartphone maker Honor - which the manufacturer says ran the distance in 9.32 seconds in a test run.

Other events at the robot games, which started on Saturday, include boxing and football, but also household tasks such as folding laundry.
body.zh: 在中国举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人跑得比尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的 1 亿米短跑世界纪录还要快，从而超越了人类。 由北京仿人机器人创新中心研发的仿人机器人在比赛中跑出了9.39秒的成绩。 八届奥运会金牌得主博尔特在 2009 年以 9.58 秒跑完 100m 的成绩创造了人类世界纪录。 该机器人击败了另外两个机器人，其中包括中国智能手机制造商荣耀制造的一个机器人，该制造商表示，该机器人在测试运行中仅用了 9.32 秒就跑完了距离。 周六开始的机器人比赛的其他项目包括拳击和足球，还有叠衣服等家务活。

reflection.en: The sight of a machine clocking 9.39 seconds in Beijing challenges our understanding of physical limits and the 'prize' of athletic achievement. While a robot can be engineered for singular mechanical efficiency, the human race involves a holistic discipline of the soul and body that reflects the wisdom of Yahweh. We celebrate human ingenuity in creating...
reflection.zh: 在北京看到机器跑出9.39秒的成绩，挑战了我们对体能极限和竞技“奖赏”的理解。虽然机器人可以为了单一的机械效率而设计，但人类的赛程包含了反映雅伟智慧的身心全面操练。我们赞叹人类创造此类工具的智慧，但我们也记得，人的终极价值不在于成为最快的“机器”。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: A teenager's death has prompted fresh calls for relationship education
title.zh: 一名青少年的死亡引发了对人际关系教育的新呼声

summary.en: A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at a home on Sydney's Northern Beaches on Sunday but died in hospital on Tuesday.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A teenage girl's tragic death, which has been reported as being linked to sexual choking, has sparked high-profile calls for broadened relationship education.

A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at an Elanora Heights home, on Sydney's Northern Beaches, on Sunday.

Police declined to confirm reports detectives were investigating sexual choking as a possible factor in the death.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Independent MP Zali Steggall mentioned the reports after a National Cabinet meeting on Wednesday affirmed a commitment to ending gender-based violence.

She said agreed measures were weak and pushed for more action, including a respectful relationship education campaign.

"My call for a national education campaign has been underscored by the devastating news today of the death of a 16-year-old Northern Beaches girl," Steggall said in a statement.

"My thoughts are with her family, friends and community at this incredibly difficult time."

Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said there was no safe way to engage in choking.

"I'm sure I've said it to you in the past almost 60 per cent of young people report they've experienced choking in a recent sexual encounter," she told ABC Radio on Thursday morning.

"I can't say anything, obviously, about this tragic situation in NSW ... but in general terms, figures like that just concern me so deeply.

"There is no safe way of choking someone. Parents have to use this opportunity to talk to their young people."

A survey of 4702 Australians between 18 and 35 in 2024 found 57 per cent of respondents had been choked during sex at least once.

One-third of those respondents reported it occurring for the first time between 19 and 21.

The report's co-author noted choking in a sexual context could lead to serious brain injuries, including memory loss and issues with problem-solving.

"It doesn't matter if there are no apparent injuries, or whether the person consented," Professor Heather Douglas said at the time.

"Brain injury can also be incremental — getting a bit worse with each choking — and the person may not know they have suffered a brain injury. The effects of repeated strangling are insidious and build over time."

body.zh: 据报道，一名少女的惨死与性窒息有关，这引发了人们对扩大关系教育的高调呼吁。 周日，一名 16 岁女孩被发现在悉尼北部海滩埃拉诺拉高地 (Elanora Heights) 的一处家中失去知觉。 警方拒绝证实侦探正在调查性窒息可能是死亡原因的报道。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 独立议员扎利·斯特格尔在周三的国家内阁会议确认了结束性别暴力的承诺后提到了这些报告。 她表示商定的措施很薄弱，并敦促采取更多行动，包括开展相互尊重的关系教育活动。 斯特格尔在一份声明中说：“今天一名 16 岁北部海滩女孩死亡的毁灭性消息凸显了我对全国教育运动的呼吁。” “在这个极其困难的时刻，我的心与她的家人、朋友和社区同在。” 社会服务部长塔尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 表示，没有安全的方法可以让孩子窒息。 “我确信我过去曾对你说过，近 60% 的年轻人表示他们在最近的性接触中经历过窒息，”她周四早上告诉 ABC 电台。 “显然，对于新南威尔士州的这一悲惨局势，我无法说什么……但总的来说，这样的数字让我深感担忧。 “没有安全的方法可以让某人窒息。父母必须利用这个机会与年轻人交谈。” 2024 年对 4702 名 18 岁至 35 岁的澳大利亚人进行的一项调查发现，57% 的受访者在性行为中至少被窒息过一次。 三分之一的受访者表示第一次发生这种情况是在 19 岁至 21 岁之间。 该报告的合著者指出，在性行为中窒息可能会导致严重的脑损伤，包括记忆丧失和解决问题的问题。 希瑟·道格拉斯教授当时表示：“是否没有明显的伤害，或者当事人是否同意，这并不重要。” “脑损伤也可能是渐进的——每次窒息都会变得更严重——而且患者可能不知道自己已经遭受了脑损伤。反复勒死的影响是阴险的，并且会随着时间的推移而增强。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Australia wants more data centres. A disagreement over power sources stands in the way
title.zh: 澳大利亚需要更多的数据中心。电源问题上的分歧阻碍了

summary.en: Proposed legislation to force data centre developers to provide their own renewable energy sources has run into resistance.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two jurisdictions have forced the prime minister to back down on a major policy that would have required all new AI data centres to be powered by renewable energy rather than coal and gas.

Anthony Albanese left the door open at a meeting of the nation's leaders on Wednesday to a more "flexible" approach as Queensland and the Northern Territory refused to agree to standards requiring them to use renewables for new data centre developments.

He announced the agreement on the AI laws alongside domestic violence measures and firearm reforms following a meeting of National Cabinet in Sydney.

"We want to make sure that in attracting investment, we don't have eight different systems operating around the country," he said on Wednesday.

"That's why we came to a common position, which recognises that all states aren't exactly the same, and that was accommodated in the way that we normally do in a flexible way."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas said the nation's leaders agreed renewables would be the main form of energy to power future data centres in Australia.

"Acknowledging that there are different circumstances through the fact that in Queensland, for instance, they have state-owned generation," he told ABC's 7.30 on Wednesday.

"So there's no need for the federal government to use its powers that it has to override what states want."

Gregor Verbic, an energy expert at Sydney University, said the national grid was facing the imminent closure of multiple coal-fired power stations.

"(It) will leave a huge gap in the generation capacity, and we are not building new capacity fast enough," he told the Australian Associated Press news agency.

The federal government has proposed legislation to force data centre developers to provide their own renewable energy source.

Both the Queensland and NT governments provided considerable pushback, with the final national agreement failing to mention renewable energy directly.

Verbic said ensuring the energy brought online is renewable is essential to meet Australia's emissions reduction targets.

Albanese flagged draft legislation will be introduced by the end of 2026, with the aim for it to be passed in early 2027.

body.zh: 两个司法管辖区迫使总理放弃一项重大政策，该政策要求所有新的人工智能数据中心均由可再生能源而不是煤炭和天然气供电。 由于昆士兰州和北领地拒绝同意要求他们使用可再生能源进行新数据中心开发的标准，安东尼·阿尔博内斯在周三的国家领导人会议上为采取更“灵活”的方法敞开了大门。 在悉尼举行的国家内阁会议后，他宣布就人工智能法以及家庭暴力措施和枪支改革达成协议。 “我们希望确保在吸引投资时，我们不会在全国各地运营八个不同的系统，”他周三表示。 “这就是为什么我们达成了共同立场，承认所有州并不完全相同，并且我们以通常灵活的方式进行了适应。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 南澳大利亚州州长 Peter Malinauskas 表示，国家领导人同意可再生能源将成为澳大利亚未来数据中心供电的主要能源形式。 “承认存在不同的情况，例如在昆士兰州，他们有国有发电，”他周三告诉美国广播公司的 7.30。 “因此，联邦政府没有必要使用其权力来推翻各州的意愿。” 悉尼大学能源专家Gregor Verbic表示，国家电网面临着多个燃煤发电站即将关闭的问题。 他告诉澳大利亚美联社：“这将在发电能力方面留下巨大缺口，而我们建设新能力的速度不够快。” 联邦政府已提议立法，迫使数据中心开发商提供自己的可再生能源。 昆士兰州和北领地政府都提出了相当大的阻力，最终的国家协议没有直接提及可再生能源。 韦尔比克表示，确保上网能源是可再生能源对于实现澳大利亚的减排目标至关重要。 阿尔巴尼亚提出的立法草案将于 2026 年底提出，目标是在 2027 年初获得通过。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Humanitarian visas slashed: What we know so far about Labor's migration reforms
title.zh: 人道主义签证大幅削减：迄今为止我们对工党移民改革的了解

summary.en: Labor has been signalling an upcoming shift in its migration policy but has repeatedly pushed the announcement back.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Albanese government is expected to reduce Australia's humanitarian intake by a third as part of a wider series of reforms aimed at reducing net overseas migration, SBS understands.

First reported in The Australian Financial Review newspaper, Labor looks poised to reduce humanitarian placements from 20,000 to 13,750 at the start of the next financial year and has factored the decrease into migration forecasts.

A spokesman for Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told SBS News that the final decision on the humanitarian intake for next year is not yet settled and it’s likely to be linked to next year’s budget process.

In the wake of multiple international conflicts around the world, Labour made a series of increases to the humanitarian intake, pushing it to its current high.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The announcement comes as the government is expected to announce an overhaul to its migration policy.

Labor had been expected to reveal details in a National Press Club address by Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke earlier this month, but the speech was cancelled after Burke failed to secure cabinet agreement on the best approach.

Since then, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has refused to give further updates, telling ABC radio on Tuesday that there are a "series of plans in place" but there is still "more work to do" to finalise them. He declined to set a timeframe for immigration announcements, saying only that they would come at "appropriate times".

Migration targets have been the source of recent public debate, with One Nation pushing a tough anti-migration stance and gaining in the polls.

Both major parties have sought to restrict their own immigration policies while denying that this is in response to the minor party's growing popularity.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor has said the Coalition will cap NOM at or below the number of homes built in Australia the previous year. Current building rates suggest their figure would be under 180,000; however, the Coalition is yet to announce where they would restrict immigration to reach that figure.

In 2024-2025, net overseas migration was 306,000. Labor's budgetary forecasts suggest it will decline to 225,000 by 2027-2028, after the party has made concerted efforts to bring it down from a post-pandemic peak of 568,000.

One Nation has stated its preferred migration target is 130,000, although One Nation MP David Farley claimed the party would accept an additional 100,000 essential workers at the weekend. Party leader Pauline Hanson and MP Barnaby Joyce soon corrected him in a public fallout over targets.

title.en: I left my $300k job to be my own boss. I would have never done it if I knew about this one thing

summary.en: Julian left a high-paying job to start his own business. He didn't anticipate the difficulties that would come.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich on SBS or SBS On Demand.

I was raised in poverty in western Sydney by a single mum. At dinnertime, she would wait for my four siblings and me to finish eating, and then eat whatever was left over.

My mother had nothing but worked her absolute ass off doing everything from cleaning to hospitality to put us through school and to make sure we were always clothed and fed.

To me, she was proof of the Australian principle: you can achieve your financial goals and transform your life's circumstances if you are willing to make sacrifices and work hard.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Sure, I might not have all the things the other kids in school had, but it didn't matter where I started. If I worked hard, I could still get ahead and achieve the Australian dream .

Because I had to help my mum with our household bills, I started full-time work right out of high school as a junior finance broker on $38,000 while also studying web development full-time.

For the next 10 years, I worked almost every single weekend. I sacrificed and missed out on so much.

I didn't have a passport until I got married at 23; our honeymoon was the first time I went overseas.

I missed many family barbecues, events, and parties so I could set up my own life for my future family as well as support my mum.

I just knew that anything that I could do to help my mum would be worth it after seeing her struggle financially.

By the end of that decade when I was 27, I was running teams of over 20 people and earning upwards of $300k a year.

But I was working 80 hours a week, had no work-life balance, and felt like I was spending so much time building other people's businesses who didn't necessarily appreciate it.

The sacrifices no longer felt aligned with the reward, which made me think it could be different if I were my own boss.

So, in 2020, despite many people telling me it would fail, I decided to risk it all and start my own fintech business.

It was extremely scary starting from zero and paying myself potentially $0; I had no investors — just bootstrapping.

Twice I refinanced the family home, which my wife and I bought at age 22, drawing out hundreds of thousands in equity; I sold all the shares and crypto I had been investing in since I was young; I spent the money upfront that I received from Research and Development grants; and I took out $1+ million in...
body.zh: 您应该投资股票还是房地产？上大学还值得吗，还是应该自己创业？随着财务安全的道路变得越来越模糊，《洞察》询问了有抱负的人们如何取得成功，以及澳大利亚是否是一个积累财富的好国家。观看 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 上的《洞察》剧集《致富》。 我在悉尼西部的贫困中由一位单亲妈妈抚养长大。吃饭的时候，她会等我和四个兄弟姐妹吃完，然后把剩下的吃掉。 我母亲一无所有，除了拼尽全力做一切事情，从清洁到招待，供我们完成学业，并确保我们总是有衣有食。 对我来说，她证明了澳大利亚原则：如果你愿意做出牺牲并努力工作，你就可以实现你的财务目标并改变你的生活状况。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当然，我可能没有学校里其他孩子所拥有的所有东西，但我从哪里开始并不重要。如果我努力工作，我仍然可以出人头地并实现澳大利亚梦。 因为我必须帮助妈妈支付家庭账单，所以我高中一毕业就开始全职工作，担任初级金融经纪人，年薪 38,000 美元，同时还全职学习网络开发。 在接下来的十年里，我几乎每个周末都工作。我牺牲了很多，也错过了很多。 我直到23岁结婚才拿到护照；我们的蜜月是我第一次出国。 我错过了很多家庭烧烤、活动和聚会，这样我就可以为未来的家庭建立自己的生活并支持我的妈妈。 我只知道，在看到妈妈经济困难后，我能为帮助她做的任何事情都是值得的。 到 20 世纪末，我 27 岁的时候，我已经管理着 20 多人的团队，年收入超过 30 万美元。 但我每周工作 80 小时，工作与生活无法平衡，感觉自己花了太多时间建设别人的企业，但别人不一定会欣赏。 牺牲不再与回报相一致，这让我觉得如果我是自己的老板，情况可能会有所不同。 因此，在 2020 年，尽管很多人告诉我这会失败，我还是决定冒一切风险，开始自己的金融科技业务。 从零开始并且可能给自己支付 0 美元是非常可怕的；我没有投资者——只是自力更生。 我曾两次为我和妻子在 22 岁时购买的家庭住宅进行再融资，提取了数十万的资产净值；我卖掉了我从小就投资的所有股票和加密货币；我预先花掉了从研发补助金中获得的资金；我拿出了1+00万美元...

title.en: It was Dolly Parton's proudest legacy. Now an Australian town must keep it alive
title.zh: 达莉·帕顿最引以为傲的遗产。现在，一个澳大利亚小镇必须将其延续下去

summary.en: In Australia, Dolly Parton's legacy extends far beyond music, touching the lives of 151,000 children.
summary.zh: 在澳大利亚，达莉·帕顿的遗产远不止音乐，它触及了15.1万名儿童的生活。

body.en:
In the regional NSW city of Tamworth, more than 3,000 children are reading more books because of Dolly Parton — a mark of Australia's connection to the legendary country singer, actor and philanthropist that runs deeper than one might initially think.

Parton died on Wednesday morning at 80. Tributes have poured in from around the world, but in Tamworth, the loss is more personal.

The city, dubbed the country music capital of Australia, holds an official sister-city bond with Parton's adopted hometown of Nashville and hosted Parton herself on her last Australian tour in 2014.

"It's an incredible nod to us that she would come here when most stars are looking for the big 70,000-seater auditoriums, whereas ours is 5,000 seats," Cheryl Brown, from the Tamworth Country Music Festival, told SBS News.

"So for her to come here, she certainly validated us as the country music capital and that saw us being an important part of country music here in Australia."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But it's her gift of the Imagination Library program, one of Parton's most personal philanthropic projects, that has really transformed Tamworth.

Founded in 1995 as a tribute to her illiterate father, Dolly Parton's Imagination Library is a free book-gifting program — now running across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Ireland, and Australia — that mails new, age-appropriate books to children from birth until they turn five, completely free of charge.

It has gifted more than 300 million books to children since it started 31 years ago. In Australia, more than two million of those books have been delivered to 151,000 children across 480 communities since its launch here in 2013.

In Tamworth, where the program has run since 2019, its ambassador Lisa Rennie says it has fundamentally changed how children relate to reading and literacy.

"Children from birth to the age of five are eligible to receive the books, which are chosen by qualified speech pathologists and early literacy teachers," Rennie told SBS News.

"There are currently about 3,500 children on average on the program in the Tamworth region."

Since 2019, more than 98 per cent of children born in Tamworth have been enrolled.

Families sign up at no cost, ensuring accessibility for those experiencing disadvantage — books are posted to each home each month, and caregivers are also given reading guidance sheets to help foster lifelong reading in families.

About 70 per cent of those books are by Australian authors and 10 per cent by First Nations authors.

title.en: The antisemitism royal commission hearings are over. What happens now?
title.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会听证会结束了。现在会发生什么？

summary.en: After months of evidence, the antisemitism royal commission will enter its final phase before delivering a report in December.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
After more than 340 witnesses were called to give evidence across 62 days, the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion hearings have concluded.

The inquiry was established in response to the Bondi Beach terror attack, in which 15 people were killed during a Hanukkah celebration last December. It was tasked with investigating the circumstances of the attack, the impact of antisemitism on Jewish Australians and how social cohesion can be promoted.

The ninth and final block of hearings concluded on Wednesday , after examining how social cohesion could be understood, measured and promoted.

The inquiry will now turn to preparation of a final report, authored by commissioner Virginia Bell, who will summarise submissions, analyse evidence, establish facts and make recommendations.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As with the interim report released in April, some material may remain confidential because of national security concerns or to avoid prejudicing criminal proceedings.

The sole surviving alleged gunman, Naveed Akram, has been charged with terror and murder offences, in a case that is separate from the commission. He has yet to enter a plea.

The commission does not determine criminal guilt or impose criminal penalties. It can, however, refer matters to law enforcement or prosecuting authorities.

Its recommendations will be considered by governments, which will decide whether and how to implement them.

Bell was due to submit her final report by 14 December — the one-year anniversary of the shooting — but she has requested a four-day deadline extension.

That request was in response to concern from Australia's Jewish community that the report coming out on the day of the anniversary of the attack would be a distraction from memorials.

Leaders of Australia's Jewish community expressed gratitude for those who gave evidence at the commission, often at a personal cost.

The commission heard directly from roughly 14,000 community members through evidence submitted in person and in writing, Bell said.

Executive Council of Australian Jewry co-chief Peter Werheim said the community had put its heart and soul into the commission.

"Hundreds of people have told the truth about their everyday experience of antisemitism, and thousands more have provided detailed accounts through written submissions. We thank everyone who has made a contribution. The commissioner has a great deal of evidence to weigh, and we trust her to do that carefully."

summary.en: Hong Kong residential home prices have snapped a 13-month run of gains, according to data by the Rating and Valuation Department. Its property price index measuring average home prices in all sizes dropped 0.46 percent to 321.5 in July On a year-on-year basis, the index rose...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Hong Kong residential home prices have snapped a 13-month run of gains, according to data by the Rating and Valuation Department. Its property price index measuring average home prices in all sizes dropped 0.46 percent to 321.5 in July On a year-on-year basis, the index rose 11.6 percent. For the first seven months of this year, the reading gained 7.3 percent. By flat size, prices of small and medium sized flats fell 0.46 percent in July, while prices of luxury flats dropped 0.31 percent — their first monthly decline in a year. "As residential property prices have increased by 7.3 percent year to date, further upside is expected to be limited in the short term. The residential market is likely to enter a consolidation phase in the coming months," Eddie Kwok, Executive Director, Valuation & Advisory Services, CBRE Hong Kong said. Kwok said new home transaction volumes are expected to fall in the second half of this year, leading to a slight decline in overall 2026 new home sales. Meanwhile, rent levels hit new highs. The rental index by the the Rating and Valuation department recorded a gain of 0.77 percent to 207.4 in July — the ninth consecutive monthly gain. The cumulative gain in the first seven months of this year reached 3.4 percent. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 差饷物业估价署的数据显示，香港住宅价格结束了连续 13 个月的上涨势头。 7月份，全国各类住宅平均价格指数下降0.46%至321.5，同比上涨11.6%。今年前七个月，该指数上涨了 7.3%。按户型划分，7月份中小型住宅价格下跌0.46%，豪华住宅价格下跌0.31%，为年内首次月度下跌。世邦魏理仕香港估值及咨询服务部执行董事Eddie Kwok表示：“由于住宅物业价格今年迄今已上涨7.3%，预计短期内进一步上涨的空间有限。未来几个月住宅市场可能会进入整合阶段。”郭表示，预计今年下半年新屋交易量将下降，导致2026年新屋销售整体略有下降。与此同时，租金水平创下新高。 7 月份，差饷与估价部门的租金指数上涨 0.77%，至 207.4，连续第九个月上涨。今年前7个月累计涨幅达3.4%。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: 'Tiered emergency mechanism trial should be extended'
title.zh: “分级应急机制试点应延长”

summary.en: An education veteran on Thursday said the trial period of a mechanism that helps to identify primary four to six students with higher suicidal risks at an early stage, and offer timely support, should be extended for at least a year. The nine-month test run for the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: An education veteran on Thursday said the trial period of a mechanism that helps to identify primary four to six students with higher suicidal risks at an early stage, and offer timely support, should be extended for at least a year. The nine-month test run for the government-led Three-Tier School-based Emergency Mechanism is set to conclude at the end of this month. From December 2025 to June this year, 14 cases were referred to the Hospital Authority’s psychiatric specialist services. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, Langton Cheung, honorary chairman of the Hong Kong Aided Primary School Heads Association, said the figure highlighted the necessity of the mechanism, and the pilot-run — which he described as “short” — should go on for at least another year before a review is carried out for enhancement. The education sector hopes the system can be regularised in a gradual manner, he added. Cheung also said that parents play a crucial role in helping to identify pupils for early identification and intervention. “When we identify a problem but the parents do not agree, and they are in denial or refuse to acknowledge it... when that situation arises, it actually puts schools in a difficult position. Because when we seek help under this emergency mechanism, we also need the parents’ consent.” The mechanism, therefore, could be enhanced by stepping up cooperation between schools and parents, he added. Cheung said the mechanism also offers peace of mind to schools, as a dedicated consultation hotline is in place for principals to seek professional advice. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 一位教育界资深人士周四表示，一项有助于及早识别自杀风险较高的小四至六年级学生并提供及时支持的机制的试用期应至少延长一年。政府主导的校本三级应急机制为期九个月的试运行将于本月底结束。由2025年12月至今年6月，共有14宗个案转介至医院管理局精神科专科服务。香港资助小学校长会名誉主席张兰顿在香港电台节目中表示，这个数字突显了该机制的必要性，而他形容“短暂”的试点应该至少再持续一年，然后再进行检讨以加强机制。他补充说，教育部门希望这一制度能够逐步正规化。张还表示，家长在帮助识别学生以进行早期识别和干预方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 “当我们发现一个问题，但家长不同意，他们否认或拒绝承认……当这种情况出现时，实际上会让学校陷入困境。因为当我们在这个紧急机制下寻求帮助时，我们也需要家长的同意。”他补充说，因此，可以通过加强学校和家长之间的合作来加强这一机制。张表示，该机制也让学校安心，因为学校设有专门的咨询热线，供校长寻求专业意见。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: Search for 1,000 missing after deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏发生致命洪水后寻找1,000名失踪人员

summary.en: Rescue teams rushed Thursday to find more than 1,000 people missing on the Nepal-Tibet border in flash floods and landslides that killed at least 165 and swept away entire villages. A terrifying clip of surveillance video from the Chinese side of the frontier shows a massive...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Rescue teams rushed Thursday to find more than 1,000 people missing on the Nepal-Tibet border in flash floods and landslides that killed at least 165 and swept away entire villages. Rescuers use an excavator to transport a flood survivor, following flash floods and a landslide disaster in Devghat, in the Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 26, 2026. Photo: Prakesh Mathema/AFP. A terrifying clip of surveillance video from the Chinese side of the frontier shows a massive wall of mud and debris crashing over a building several stories high on Wednesday morning, engulfing it as dozens of people ran for their lives below. The surge swept away buses and cars like they were toys. Many of the missing are foreign tourists, officials said of the disaster, which the US Geological Survey believe was caused by a glacial collapse that sent a flow of debris engulfing areas along the way. The tsunami-like rumble of water and mud struck villages and towns on the path of two rivers — Bhote Koshi and Trishuli, with Nepali police saying they had recovered 162 bodies. Across the border, Chinese state media said the “mudslide disaster” at the Gyirong Port in Tibet claimed three lives while 558 people, including 260 foreigners, were still missing. Raju Bhadel, 56, a businessman in Nepal’s Nuwakot district, recounted receiving a call from his brother-in-law in distress. “They were crying and said their entire house had been swept away. Three family members were rescued, but his brother is still missing,” he said. Also at Nuwakot, teacher Manok Mishra witnessed “nine trucks being swept away by the floods including people”. ‘Inland tsunami’ Rescuers waded through mud and sludge to look for survivors after floodwaters buried the lower floors of multi-storey buildings. Some 468 tourists — 393 of them foreigners — were unaccounted for a day after the disaster struck, according to Nepal’s tourism ministry. Houses lie partially submerged in muddy water along a riverside after flash floods at Trishuli Bazar in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 26, 2026. Photo: Prabin Ranabhat/AFP. Nepal did not provide a figure for residents in affected areas who are still missing. On China’s end, rescuers were seeking 558 missing, including 260 foreign nationals, according to local officials quoted by state broadcaster CCTV. The foreigners out of contact included Indians, and others from Australia, Britain, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Portugal, South Africa, South Korea and the United States, Nepal’s tourism board said. The rush of mud and debris was “like an inland tsunami, travelling nearly 170 kilometres down the Bhote Koshi valley into Central Nepal”, said environmental historian...
body.zh: 星期四，尼泊尔和西藏边境发生山洪和山体滑坡，救援队赶到，发现有 1000 多人失踪，山体滑坡造成至少 165 人死亡，整个村庄被冲走。 2026 年 8 月 26 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区德夫加特发生山洪暴发和山体滑坡灾难后，救援人员使用挖掘机运送洪水幸存者。照片：Prakesh Mathema/法新社。来自边境中国一侧的一段可怕的监控视频显示，周三早上，一堵由泥土和碎片组成的巨大墙倒塌在几层楼高的建筑物上，吞没了建筑物，数十人在下面逃命。浪潮席卷了公共汽车和汽车，就像它们是玩具一样。官员们在谈到这场灾难时表示，许多失踪者是外国游客。美国地质调查局认为，这场灾难是由冰川崩塌造成的，崩塌导致碎片流吞没沿途地区。海啸般的水流和泥浆袭击了博特科希河和特里苏利河两道沿线的村庄和城镇，尼泊尔警方表示，他们已经找到了 162 具尸体。边境另一边，中国官方媒体称，西藏吉隆口岸发生的“泥石流灾害”造成三人死亡，仍有 558 人失踪，其中包括 260 名外国人。 56 岁的拉朱·巴德尔 (Raju Bhadel) 是尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的一名商人，他讲述了接到遇险姐夫打来的电话的经历。 “他们哭着说他们的整个房子都被冲走了。三名家庭成员获救，但他的兄弟仍然失踪，”他说。同样在努瓦科特，老师马诺克·米什拉目睹了“九辆卡车被洪水冲走，其中包括人”。 “内陆海啸”洪水淹没了多层建筑的较低楼层后，救援人员在泥浆中涉水寻找幸存者。据尼泊尔旅游部称，灾难发生一天后，约有 468 名游客（其中 393 名外国人）下落不明。 2026 年 8 月 26 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区 Trishuli Bazar 发生山洪，河边部分房屋被淹没在泥水中。照片：Prabin Ranabhat/法新社。尼泊尔没有提供受影响地区仍然失踪的居民人数。据中央电视台援引当地官员的话称，中国方面，救援人员正在寻找 558 名失踪人员，其中包括 260 名外国人。尼泊尔旅游局表示，失去联系的外国人包括印度人以及来自澳大利亚、英国、马来西亚、荷兰、葡萄牙、南非、韩国和美国的其他人。环境历史学家表示，泥浆和碎片的涌动“就像一场内陆海啸，沿着博特​​科希山谷传播近 170 公里，进入尼泊尔中部”。

title.en: Wild pigs and pampered pooches: Hong Kong’s complex relationship with animals
title.zh: 野猪和被宠坏的狗：香港与动物的复杂关系

summary.en: “Some we love, some we hate, some we eat,” was the title of a best-selling exploration of the relationship between humans and animals, with subtitle “Why it’s so hard to think straight about animals.” The spectrum actually goes much wider than love, hatred and food. It includes...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: “Some we love, some we hate, some we eat,” was the title of a best-selling exploration of the relationship between humans and animals, with subtitle “Why it’s so hard to think straight about animals.” Pixel the HKFP dog. Photo: HKFP. The spectrum actually goes much wider than love, hatred and food. It includes animals as tourist attractions, animals as a mechanism for gambling, animals as laboratory subjects, and (still) animals as workers. And so on. There is also the matter of more than one relationship coexisting. There was a touching moment in one edition of Clarkson’s Farm , in which Mr C accepted delivery of a consignment of sausages which were formerly some of his pigs. He muses on the paradox of livestock farming, that you love the animals and then send them to be killed. “Well” says the sausage delivery man happily, “now you can love them in a different way.” There seems to be a rather similar ambiguity in the Hong Kong government’s relationship with dogs. The traditional attitude was of unmistakable disapproval; licences were issued but this was mainly a way to encourage vaccination against rabies. Public parks and public housing both excluded dogs. Earlier in the year, this seemed to have mellowed. Restaurants which wished to do so could apply for a permit to admit dogs. This coincided with the rise of the dog stroller, a sort of pram in which your pooch could visit a mall without his paws touching the floor. I now occasionally encounter small dogs in supermarkets. Pet dogs inside Wan Land Mori cafe in Kowloon City on July 12, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But over the last couple of weeks, the relationship has become tricky again. Two dogs featured in horror stories: one fatally mauled two smaller dogs and the other killed the proprietor of a dog hotel . The official response was to reiterate the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department’s safety doctrine, which is that dogs weighing more than 20 kg should be walked on a leash not more than two metres long. This seems to be based on the fallacious idea that large dogs are more belligerent than small ones ( the dog which took a hunk out of me was one of those little Japanese jobs) and that short leashes give you more help than long ones (if your dog is a big puller, the solution is to wear the leash round your waist). Meanwhile, there was much anguish online over a China dog story. This involved a dog, usually referred to as Wang Wang, being killed in an unconscionably cruel way by a group of boys, who then beat her puppies to death. This struck a chord in Hong Kong, leading several people to put pictures and tributes in public places . This, in turn, drew the attention of the national security paranoia people, who get the collywobbles over any wave of...
body.zh: “有些我们爱，有些我们恨，有些我们吃”，这是一本探讨人类与动物关系的畅销书的标题，副标题是“为什么直接思考动物如此困难”。像素 HKFP 狗。照片：香港新闻社。事实上，这个范围比爱、恨和食物要广泛得多。它包括作为旅游景点的动物、作为赌博机制的动物、作为实验对象的动物以及作为工人的（仍然）动物。等等。还有不止一种关系并存的问题。在《克拉克森农场》的一期中有一个感人的时刻，C 先生接受了一批香肠，这些香肠以前是他的一些猪。他思考了畜牧业的悖论：你爱动物，却又把它们送去宰杀。 “好吧，”香肠送货员高兴地说，“现在你可以用不同的方式来爱它们了。”香港政府与狗的关系似乎也存在类似的模糊性。传统的态度是明确的反对。颁发了许可证，但这主要是鼓励接种狂犬病疫苗的一种方式。公园和公共住房都禁止狗入内。今年早些时候，这种情况似乎有所缓和。希望这样做的餐馆可以申请允许狗进入的许可证。这恰逢狗推车的兴起，这是一种婴儿车，你的狗可以用它去商场而不用爪子接触地板。我现在偶尔在超市遇到小狗。 2026 年 7 月 12 日，九龙城 Wan Land Mori 咖啡馆内的宠物狗。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但在过去的几周里，这种关系再次变得棘手。恐怖故事中出现了两只狗：一只咬死了两只较小的狗，另一只杀死了一家狗旅馆的老板。官方回应是重申渔农自然护理署的安全准则，即体重超过20公斤的狗只应使用长度不超过两米的皮带遛狗。这似乎是基于一种错误的想法，即大型狗比小型狗更好战（那只把我打垮的狗就是那些日本小工作之一），而且短皮带比长皮带给你更多的帮助（如果你的狗是一个大拉手，解决方案是将皮带戴在你的腰上）。与此同时，网上关于中国狗的故事引起了很大的痛苦。这涉及到一只通常被称为旺旺的狗被一群男孩以不合情理的残忍方式杀害，然后男孩又将她的小狗打死。这在香港引起了共鸣，不少人在公共场所张贴照片和悼念。这反过来又引起了国家安全偏执狂的注意，他们对任何一波浪潮都会感到不安……

summary.en: A taxi driver has been sentenced to eight weeks in prison and fined HK$3,000 after he was caught overcharging an undercover police officer and then sped away to flee the scene. Chan Wai-kee, 64, appeared at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday, local media reported. He...

body.en: A taxi driver has been sentenced to eight weeks in prison and fined HK$3,000 after he was caught overcharging an undercover police officer and then sped away to flee the scene. Photo: Lea Mok/HKFP Chan Wai-kee, 64, appeared at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday, local media reported . He pleaded guilty to one count of careless driving and two charges related to overcharging. Chan admitted to committing the offences on April 29, when an undercover police officer boarded his taxi as part of a sting operation in Happy Valley targeting rogue taxi drivers. According to case details, Chan quoted a flat fare of HK$280 when the officer asked in Mandarin to go to the InterContinental Grand Stanford Hong Kong in Tsim Sha Tsui – around HK$150 more than the legally prescribed rate. Chan then drove off without starting the taximeter. Upon arriving at the hotel, the undercover officer paid with cash and exited the vehicle. Another plainclothes officer then approached the driver’s window and identified himself as police. Chan accelerated suddenly and sped away, endangering the officers and nearby pedestrians. The following day, he surrendered to police, identifying himself as the driver involved in the incident. Eastern Magistrates Court. Photo: Selina Cheng/HKFP. The court heard that Chan had 32 prior criminal convictions, including some linked to overcharging and similar offences. He also had seven earlier traffic convictions, including two for careless driving. The defence highlighted Chan’s voluntary surrender in mitigation, saying that it demonstrated genuine remorse, and argued that he was unlikely to reoffend since the taxi association would no longer issue him a license. Principal Magistrate David Cheung said that Chan risked injury to others in attempting to flee, and he therefore considered imprisonment appropriate. Under Hong Kong law, the maximum penalty for overcharging is six months’ imprisonment and a fine of HK$10,000. Careless driving also carries a maximum penalty of six months in prison, as well as a $5,000 fine.
body.zh: 一名出租车司机因向便衣警察过度收费后扬长而去逃离现场，被判入狱八周并罚款港币三千元。据当地媒体报道，64 岁的陈惠琪 (Chan Wai-kee) 周二在东区裁判法院出庭。他承认一项粗心驾驶罪名和两项与多收费有关的指控。 4月29日，陈先生承认犯下这些罪行，当时一名便衣警察登上了他的出租车，这是跑马地针对流氓出租车司机的诱捕行动的一部分。根据案件详情，当官员用普通话要求前往尖沙咀香港海景嘉福洲际酒店时，陈报出统一票价280港元，比法定票价高出约150港元。陈先生随后开车离开，没有启动出租车计价器。到达酒店后，便衣人员用现金付款并下了车。随后，另一名便衣警察走近驾驶员车窗，自称警察。陈先生突然加速并扬长而去，危及警察和附近的行人。第二天，他向警方自首，并自称是涉案司机。东区裁判法院。照片：Selina Cheng/HKFP。法庭获悉，Chan 此前曾有 32 项刑事定罪，其中一些与过度收费和类似犯罪有关。他此前还曾有过七次交通犯罪记录，其中两次是因为粗心驾驶。辩方强调陈先生自愿投案自首，称其表现出真正的悔恨，并辩称他不太可能再次犯罪，因为出租车协会将不再向他颁发执照。首席裁判官张大卫表示，陈先生试图逃跑时冒着伤害他人的风险，因此他认为监禁是适当的。根据香港法律，多收费的最高刑罚为监禁六个月及罚款港币一万元。粗心驾驶最高可判处六个月监禁以及 5,000 美元罚款。

body.en: The Observatory issued the red rainstorm warning at 5.05am on Thursday as heavy rain battered the city. Classes of all AM schools and whole-day schools were suspended. The Drainage Services Department asked members of the public to report any street flooding. The Labour Department said employers should make work arrangements for their employees as soon as possible. The red rainstorm warning lasted till 9.20am when it was replaced by the amber warning. Authorities said classes of PM schools will proceed as usual unless advised otherwise. The Drainage Services Department said it activated its emergency control centre and deployed 90 emergency response teams to handle possible flooding reports, conducting repeated inspections and clearing some 240 locations across Hong Kong that are prone to flooding due to blockage when the red rainstorm flooding was in effect. As of 9am, the authorities had confirmed no flooding cases. The department said it will maintain close communication and cooperation with the Observatory and the Highways Department, and reminded the public that during adverse weather, heavy rain may cause rivers to surge suddenly and people should stay away from waterways and drainage channels. _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-08-27 HKT 12:11 Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 由于大雨袭击全市，天文台于星期四早上5时05分发出红色暴雨警告。所有AM学校和全日制学校停课。渠务署要求公众举报任何街道水浸情况。劳工处表示，雇主应尽快为雇员作出工作安排。红色暴雨警告持续至上午9时20分，随后被黄色警告取代。当局表示，除非另有通知，PM学校的课程将照常进行。渠务署表示，已启动紧急控制中心，派出90支紧急应变队处理可能发生的水浸报告，并在红色暴雨水浸发生期间，反复巡查并清理全港约240个因堵塞而易受水浸的地点。截至上午9点，当局确认没有发生洪水案件。署方表示会与天文台及路政署保持紧密沟通和合作，并提醒市民，在恶劣天气下，大雨可能导致河水突然涌动，市民应远离水道和排水道。 _____________________________ 最后更新: 2026-08-27 香港时间 12:11 编辑：Robert Kemp

body.en: Police on Wednesday said they arrested two women, after viral video footage showed a young girl being slapped in the face. In the video circulating online, a girl can be seen falling to the ground after being struck. It is understood that two 34-year-old mothers took their children to the APM shopping mall in Kwun Tong at around 4pm, when an argument broke out over the use of play facilities. During the dispute, a 68-year-old, who is the mother of one of the women, allegedly slapped the five-year-old girl. The girl's mother is also suspected of assaulting the other 34-year-old woman. Three people were taken to United Christian Hospital for treatment. The Kwun Tong District Crime Division is looking into the incident. Edited by Aaron Tam

title.en: North Korea to ‘bring joy’ to Kim with 100 athletes at Asian Games
title.zh: 朝鲜将携100名运动员参加亚运会为金正恩“带来欢乐”

summary.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. This picture taken on August 16, 2026 and released by North Korea’s official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) via KNS on August 17, 2026 shows North Korean leader Kim Jong Un (centre R) and his daughter Kim Ju Ae watching swimming and diving competitions, to mark the 81st anniversary of the end of World War II in Pyongyang. Photo: KCNA via KNS/AFP. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the Covid pandemic but returned at the Asian Games in China in 2023 and also took part in the Paris Olympics. The team for the regional Games in Nagoya and the Aichi region includes two Japan-based ethnic Koreans competing in women’s football and karate, said Ko Chol Ho, secretary general of North Korea’s Olympic committee. “Our delegation will send more than 100 athletes to compete in 14 sports, including men’s and women’s football, weightlifting, boxing and wrestling,” Ko told Choson Sinbo, a pro-North Korean publication based in Japan, during an interview in Pyongyang. Kim Jong Un. File photo: USGov. “We are making every effort, driven by a strong desire to live up to the expectations of our country and people by achieving even greater results at the upcoming Games,” the official said, in remarks published Tuesday. He noted that the delegation would be smaller than the one sent to the Hangzhou Games of 2023 but said he hoped it would win more medals. Authoritarian North Korea won 11 golds last time, half of them in weightlifting. The official said that morale among the athletes was high for the event, which runs from September 19 to October 4, and they were motivated to win for their leader. “Our athletes are training tirelessly every day, determined to bring joy to Marshal Kim,” he said. North Korea has recently been hurling criticism at Japan, a former regional colonial power, over what Pyongyang describes as its remilitarisation.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，朝鲜将派出约 100 名运动员参加下个月在日本举行的亚运会，参加 14 个项目的比赛，旨在“为金正恩元帅带来欢乐”。这张拍摄于 2026 年 8 月 16 日、朝鲜官方朝中社 (KCNA) 通过 KNS 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日发布的照片​​显示，朝鲜领导人金正恩（中右）和他的女儿金珠爱正在观看游泳和跳水比赛，以纪念平壤第二次世界大战结束 81 周年。照片：朝中社/法新社。这个拥有核武器的国家在新冠病毒大流行期间暂停了参加国际体育比赛，但在 2023 年中国亚运会上回归，还参加了巴黎奥运会。朝鲜奥委会秘书长高哲浩表示，参加名古屋和爱知地区地区运动会的代表队包括两名居住在日本的朝鲜族选手，她们参加女子足球和空手道比赛。 “我们代表团将派出100多名运动员参加14个项目的比赛，包括男女足球、举重、拳击和摔跤，”高在平壤接受采访时告诉日本亲朝鲜出版物《朝鲜新报》。金正恩.资料图：美国政府。这位官员在周二发表的讲话中表示：“我们正在尽一切努力，强烈希望在即将到来的奥运会上取得更好的成绩，不辜负我们国家和人民的期望。”他指出，代表团规模将比参加 2023 年杭州奥运会的代表团规模要小，但他表示希望代表团能赢得更多奖牌。独裁的朝鲜上次赢得了 11 枚金牌，其中一半是举重金牌。这位官员表示，在9月19日至10月4日举行的这项赛事中，运动员们士气高昂，他们有动力为自己的领袖赢得胜利。 “我们的运动员每天都在不知疲倦地训练，决心为金元帅带来欢乐，”他说。朝鲜最近一直对前地区殖民国家日本提出批评，平壤称其为重新军事化。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? title.en: How can you see Friday's 'Magical' Blood Moon?
title.zh: 如何才能看到周五的“神奇”血月？

summary.en: A blood red moon may be visible in the early hours of Friday during a partial lunar eclipse.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Stargazers across the West have a chance to see a rare Blood Moon this week, with the Sun, Earth and Moon set to line up in the night sky just weeks after the UK experienced its most dramatic partial solar eclipse in nearly 30 years.

A partial lunar eclipse will take place in the early hours of Friday, when the Moon enters Earth's darkest shadow. The lack of light hitting the Moon will give it an eerie reddish glow.

Adding to the spectacle, its position in the sky will be low on the horizon, causing a phenomenon known as the 'Moon Illusion', when it appears much larger than normal.

Jonathan Hall, from the Bath Astronomers Society, said: "I think they [Blood Moon's] have a certain sort of magical feeling about them."

The Moon will begin to enter the Earth's darkest shadow, known as the umbra, at around 03:33 BST on Friday morning.

The Blood Moon will be at its most stark across the West at about 05:12 BST, when around 90% of the Moon will be within the umbra.

At this point the Moon will also be very low in the south-western sky, which will make it appear much larger than is usually the case.

"The lower the moon appears above the horizon, the bigger it can appear to the human eye. Although in honesty if you measured it, it's a fraction of a difference.

As with any kind of lunar event, getting to high ground will give you the best chance of a great view.

That means places like Troopers Hill, Perrett's Park or the Clifton Observatory could be good spots in Bristol, or Lansdown Hill in Bath.

In Gloucestershire options include Robinswood Hill, Leckhampton Hill or Crickley Hill Country Park, while if you're in Somerset, you could go for Glastonbury Tor, the Mendips or Brean Down.

In Wiltshire there is the Westbury White Horse, Hackpen Hill or Salisbury Plain.

However, after long periods of clear skies this summer, the forecast for Friday morning is not overly positive.

Stephen Dixon from the Met Office said: "The weather will be gradually turning more unsettled later this week, with frequent periods of rain and cloud for many.

"Late Thursday evening – before midnight - could see a brief visibility window for some in the southwest, but cloud is likely to increasingly hinder viewings through much of the night from the West, though it's not possible to rule out the odd clearer spell at times."

"Maybe set the alarm for 3am and just poke your head out the window and see what you think the chances are," Hall said.

body.zh: 本周，西方的观星者有机会看到罕见的血月，太阳、地球和月亮将在夜空中排成一线，而就在几周前，英国经历了近 30 年来最剧烈的日偏食。 周五凌晨将发生月偏食，届时月球将进入地球最暗的阴影。由于没有光线照射到月球，月球会发出怪异的红色光芒。 除了奇观之外，它在天空中的位置将低于地平线，当它看起来比正常情况大得多时，会导致一种称为“月亮幻觉”的现象。 巴斯天文学家协会的乔纳森·霍尔说：“我认为它们（血月）有某种神奇的感觉。” 周五早上 03:33 BST 左右，月球将开始进入地球最暗的阴影，即本影。 英国夏令时 05:12 左右，血月将在西方达到最明显的程度，届时月球的 90% 左右将位于本影内。 此时，月亮也将位于西南天空中非常低的位置，这将使它看起来比平时大得多。 “月亮在地平线上方的位置越低，在人眼看来就越大。尽管老实说，如果你测量一下，这只是一小部分差异。 与任何类型的月球活动一样，到达高地将为您提供欣赏美景的最佳机会。 这意味着像 Troopers Hill、Perrett's Park 或 Clifton Observatory 这样的地方可能是布里斯托尔或巴斯的 Lansdown Hill 的好去处。 在格洛斯特郡，您可以选择罗宾斯伍德山 (Robinswood Hill)、莱克汉普顿山 (Leckhampton Hill) 或克里克利山郊野公园 (Crickley Hill Country Park)，而如果您在萨默塞特 (Somerset)，则可以前往格拉斯顿伯里突岩 (Glastonbury Tor)、门迪普斯 (Mendips) 或布林当 (Brean Down)。 威尔特郡有韦斯特伯里白马 (Westbury White Horse)、哈克彭山 (Hackpen Hill) 或索尔兹伯里平原 (Salisbury Plain)。 然而，在经历了今年夏天长时间的晴朗天空之后，周五早上的天气预报并不太乐观。 英国气象局的斯蒂芬·迪克森表示：“本周晚些时候，天气将逐渐变得更加不稳定，许多人会频繁下雨和多云。 “周四晚间——午夜之前——西南部的一些地区可能会出现短暂的能见度窗口，但云层可能会越来越多地阻碍西方大部分时间的观测，尽管有时也不能排除奇怪的晴朗天气。” “也许把闹钟定在凌晨 3 点，然后把头伸出窗外，看看你认为机会有多大，”霍尔说。 在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Bristol。通过电子邮件或通过 WhatsApp 0800 313 4630 将您的故事想法发送给我们。

title.en: Food waste processing is 'worth the extra effort'
title.zh: 食物垃圾处理“值得付出额外的努力”

summary.en: Cornwall Council says about 36,000 tonnes of food waste has been recycled over two years.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Understanding the benefits of recycling food waste could encourage more people to do it in future, Cornwall Council has said.

For the past two years, leftover food has been able to be taken to an anaerobic digester to be converted into methane to generate electricity and produce fertiliser.

The council said about 36,000 tonnes of food waste had been recycled to date since the introduction of its new waste service.

It said it hoped increased participation through understanding the benefits would help meet its target to recycle nearly two-thirds of Cornwall's waste by 2029.

Cornwall's food waste is taken to a digester in Holsworthy, Devon, operated by Severn Trent Green Power.

Chris Lofts, the site manager, said the waste was first filtered before having water added and being fed into a digester to create methane.

"That methane we use as a fuel for engines that run generators and the generators produce electricity - and we then inject the electricity back into the National Grid," he explained.

He said they tried to make sure nothing went to waste: "We use the heat as well to pasteurise the material on site for ancillary services that we do here.

"Even the by-product, the digestate that comes out - that's used as a fertiliser for farmers to fertilise the countryside and make all the flowers and crops grow."

Lofts said recycling food was better for the environment than just throwing it in the bin with other waste to be taken to an incinerator.

He said: "The incinerators use the waste as a fuel - they burn it and heat up steam generators from that. But there is a residual, the ash, which needs to go somewhere.

"It's an imperfect procedure - you're not getting as much electricity out of it as you would do if you're sending it to us here."

He said the site could process about 1,100 tonnes of food waste a week - creating enough electricity to power 8,500 homes.

Councillor Loic Rich, portfolio holder for environment and climate change on Cornwall Council, said it was great to see residents engaging with recycling food.

He said: "We're living on a planet that we've damaged with pollution and it's time now to take a bit more responsibility.

"It's just another thing we don't really want to be chucking away to get burnt in the incinerator when it can actually be reused and put to good use."

The council said its analysis of Cornwall's household waste found food accounted for 22% of black bag rubbish - and 43% of that was still in the packaging.

Rich said he hoped that figure would decrease if people understood the benefits of recycling food waste.

"I'm just saying to people, if you're not doing your food waste, have a think about all the benefits - it's worth it.

"At the moment, we're just over 50%. I'd like to get to 65% by 2029 but we can...

title.en: How to watch the partial lunar eclipse from Northern Ireland
title.zh: 如何从北爱尔兰观看月偏食

summary.en: Skygazers may see a partial lunar eclipse early on Friday, as the Moon enters Earth's shadow.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Stargazers have the chance to see a stunning partial lunar eclipse early on Friday morning, as the moon enters Earth's shadow.

At its peak, roughly 93% of the Moon's diameter will be covered, making the event look close to a total eclipse.

For people in Northern Ireland hoping to catch a glimpse, the biggest challenge will be the early start, possible cloud cover, and the Moon's low position in the western sky.

The first phase of the eclipse begins at 02:23 BST when the Moon enters the lighter outer part of Earth's shadow, known as the penumbra.

The much more obvious stage starts at 03:33, as Earth's darker central shadow begins moving across the lunar surface, with maximum eclipse occurring at 05:12 , external .

In Belfast, the Moon will be will be low in the western sky at about nine degrees with the eclipse ending at 06:34. In Dublin, it will be slightly higher in the sky and last until 06:38.

Further west, viewers may have slightly longer before the moon disappears. In Enniskillen, moonset is 06:41 , external .

This means that visibility will not only depend on cloud cover, but also having an unobstructed view towards the west.

A lunar eclipse happens when the Sun, Earth, and Moon become aligned, allowing the Moon to pass through Earth's shadow.

During a partial eclipse, only part of the Moon enters the darkest section of that shadow, known as the umbra.

Although Earth's shadow blocks direct sunlight from reaching most of the Moon, some still passes through Earth's atmosphere.

Shorter blue wavelengths scattering more easily, while more of the longer wavelength red light reaches the moon.

"That'll be enough for it to turn a reddish colour," according to Terry Moseley from the Irish Astronomical Association.

"This is sometimes called a blood moon - which is a nice dramatic name - but it's not always the colour of blood.

"It can turn anything from orange to a deep red, but the part near the centre of the eclipse will be the most spectacular."

As the moon will be low on the western horizon, viewers will need a clear view towards the west as buildings, hills and trees could block the view as the Moon gets lower toward dawn.

Unlike a solar eclipse, no protective glasses are needed to watch a lunar eclipse - it is safe to look directly at the moon , external .

No equipment such as binoculars or telescopes are necessary, although they could make viewing the changing colours of the Moon's surface easier to see.

Clear sky will be crucial and the current forecast suggests that western areas will more favoured, with cloudier skies for central and eastern parts.
body.zh: 周五清晨，当月亮进入地球的阴影时，观星者有机会看到令人惊叹的月偏食。 在其高峰期，大约 93% 的月球直径将被覆盖，使该事件看起来接近于日全食。 对于北爱尔兰希望一睹其风采的人们来说，最大的挑战将是提早出发、可能的云层覆盖以及月亮在西方天空中的位置较低。 日食的第一阶段开始于英国夏令时 02:23，此时月球进入地球阴影较亮的外部部分（称为半影）。 更明显的阶段从 03:33 开始，地球较暗的中央阴影开始穿过月球表面，最大日食发生在 05:12（外部）。 在贝尔法斯特，月亮将在西方天空低垂约九度，月食将于 06:34 结束。在都柏林，天空会稍高，持续到 06:38。 再往西，观众在月亮消失之前可能还有稍长的时间。在恩尼斯基林，月落时间为 06:41（外部）。 这意味着能见度不仅取决于云量，还取决于对西方的无障碍视野。 当太阳、地球和月球排成一条直线，使月球穿过地球的阴影时，就会发生月食。 在日偏食期间，只有月球的一部分进入阴影最暗的部分，即本影。 尽管地球的阴影阻挡了直射阳光到达月球的大部分区域，但仍有一些阳光穿过地球的大气层。 较短的蓝色波长更容易散射，而更多的较长波长的红光到达月球。 爱尔兰天文学协会的特里·莫斯利表示：“这足以让它变成微红色。” “这有时被称为血月——这是一个很好的戏剧性名字——但它并不总是血的颜色。 “它可以将任何东西从橙色变成深红色，但日食中心附近的部分将是最壮观的。” 由于月亮将在西方地平线上较低的位置，观众需要清楚地看到西方，因为随着月亮在黎明时分降低，建筑物、山丘和树木可能会遮挡视线。 与日食不同，观看月食不需要防护眼镜 - 从外部直接观看月球是安全的。 不需要双筒望远镜或望远镜等设备，尽管它们可以使观察月球表面颜色的变化变得更容易。 晴朗的天空至关重要，目前的预测表明，西部地区将更受青睐，而中部和东部地区的天空将更加多云。

title.en: Some Galápagos 'yellow' sea turtles remain homebodies, surprising scientists
title.zh: 令科学家惊讶的是，一些加拉帕戈斯“黄”海龟仍然是居家动物

summary.en: Sea turtles are famous for being prodigious wanderers. Guided by Earth's magnetic field, ocean currents and the sun, they tend to crisscross the seas in search of food, returning to the region of their birth every few years to breed. So when scientists discovered a population of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Sea turtles are famous for being prodigious wanderers. Guided by Earth's magnetic field, ocean currents and the sun, they tend to crisscross the seas in search of food, returning to the region of their birth every few years to breed. So when scientists discovered a population of sea turtles that appear to be very much homebodies, they were taken aback.

"Here we show that 'yellow-morph' green sea turtles—one of two genetically distinct forms—occupy individual foraging areas that span one or more islands in the Galápagos. We expected them to migrate to distant beaches in the western Pacific to reproduce, yet interestingly, none of our satellite-tagged turtles even left the Galápagos Marine Reserve over the three years of our study," said Dr. John W. Rowe, a professor at Alma College in the United States and the corresponding author of a new study in Frontiers in Amphibian and Reptile Science .

Green sea turtles are unique among the seven living species in being mainly vegetarian. Hatchlings start life as omnivores, but once fully grown, their diet consists of seagrasses and algae. Yellow-morph green sea turtles roam the western Pacific Ocean's tropical and subtropical latitudes, while black morphs live in the eastern Pacific west of the Americas below Southern California. The only known waters in the world where these two coexist are around the Galápagos, where they intermingle and feed on the same species of marine plants. However, yellow morphs tend to grow faster than black morphs when young, which suggests that uncharacterized physiological differences do exist.

Rowe and colleagues set out to study the yellow morph's habitat preferences, range and movements between islands within the 198,000 square kilometers (76,400 square miles) of the Galápagos Marine Reserve. In 2015, they gently caught seven adult males and two adult females in the shallow waters off four islands. They gave them nicknames and fitted them with electronic tags that sent 'pings' to the low-orbit Argos satellite network. The scientists tracked their charges for up to 418 days, typically until the tags fell off or stopped transmitting.

Overall, the turtles preferred to stay in shallow coastal waters, although occasionally they ventured up to 25 kilometers (16 miles) offshore. Five of the nine animals stayed mostly in the vicinity of a single island during the study period, while Bernardo and Sara traveled between the islands of Isabela and San Cristóbal. Leandro trekked between Isabela and Española, while Ainoa displayed the most wanderlust: Originally tagged off San Cristóbal, she subsequently...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 海龟因其惊人的漫游能力而闻名。在地球磁场、洋流和太阳的引导下，它们往往会穿越海洋寻找食物，每隔几年就会返回出生地进行繁殖。因此，当科学家发现一群看起来非常宅的海龟时，他们大吃一惊。 “在这里，我们展示了‘黄色变形’绿海龟——两种遗传上不同的形式之一——占据了横跨加拉帕戈斯群岛一个或多个岛屿的单独觅食区域。我们预计它们会迁徙到西太平洋的遥远海滩进行繁殖，但有趣的是，在我们研究的三年里，我们的卫星标记海龟甚至没有离开加拉帕戈斯海洋保护区，”美国阿尔玛学院教授、通讯作者约翰·W·罗博士说。两栖动物和爬行动物科学前沿的一项新研究。 绿海龟在七种现存物种中是独一无二的，因为它主要是素食的。幼龟一开始是杂食动物，但一旦完全长大，它们的食物就包括海草和藻类。黄绿海龟生活在西太平洋的热带和亚热带纬度地区，而黑绿海龟则生活在南加州以下美洲西部的东太平洋地区。世界上唯一已知的这两种生物共存的水域是加拉帕戈斯群岛周围，它们在那里混合并以同一种海洋植物为食。然而，黄色变种在年轻时往往比黑色变种生长得更快，这表明确实存在未表征的生理差异。 Rowe 和同事着手研究加拉帕戈斯海洋保护区 198,000 平方公里（76,400 平方英里）内的黄色变形鱼的栖息地偏好、范围和岛屿之间的活动。 2015年，他们在四个岛屿附近的浅水区轻轻捕获了七只成年雄性和两只成年雌性。他们给它们起了昵称，并给它们安装了电子标签，可以向低轨道阿尔戈斯卫星网络发送“ping”信号。科学家们对这些电荷进行了长达 418 天的追踪，通常直到标签脱落或停止传输为止。 总体而言，海龟更喜欢呆在沿海浅水区，尽管它们偶尔也会冒险到离岸 25 公里（16 英里）的地方。在研究期间，九只动物中的五只大部分停留在一个岛屿附近，而贝尔纳多和萨拉则在伊莎贝拉岛和圣克里斯托瓦尔岛之间旅行。莱安德罗 (Leandro) 在伊莎贝拉 (Isabela) 和埃斯帕尼奥拉 (Española) 之间跋涉，而艾诺亚 (Ainoa) 则表现出最热衷的旅行：最初被标记为圣克里斯托瓦尔 (San Cristóbal)，随后她……

title.en: We finally have some encouraging news on Great Barrier Reef water quality
title.zh: 我们终于得到了一些关于大堡礁水质的令人鼓舞的消息

summary.en: Imagine a plume of brown sediment washed off the land into Queensland rivers and carried out to sea. Here, it can settle on seagrass and inshore corals, potentially smothering them. River water often also carries nitrogen from fertilizer residue, which can fuel algal growth and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Imagine a plume of brown sediment washed off the land into Queensland rivers and carried out to sea. Here, it can settle on seagrass and inshore corals, potentially smothering them. River water often also carries nitrogen from fertilizer residue, which can fuel algal growth and damage coral health.

We have long known that poor water quality is a serious threat to areas of the Great Barrier Reef close to shore. The reef faces other major challenges, such as marine heat waves driven by climate change that trigger large-scale coral bleaching. But unlike climate change, water quality is something Australia can directly control.

Since 2014, the federal and Queensland governments have collectively spent more than A$5 billion on catchment programs for reef health . Many of these aim to improve water quality by reducing fertilizer runoff from farmland and tackling erosion to stop sediment from entering waterways.

Our new research shows water quality is improving in many rivers that flow to the reef. This is good news.

To find out whether water quality is changing, our research team analyzed up to 37 years of monitoring data from seven major river systems to track changes in fertilizer runoff (dissolved inorganic nitrogen) and suspended sediment. These are two of the five key pollutants scientists use to track changes in river basins. Our research is the largest and most comprehensive analysis of catchment water quality for the reef to date.

These river basins drain around two-thirds of the Great Barrier Reef water catchments, an area the size of New Zealand. Given the complexity of the data and the size of some catchments, we did not necessarily expect to detect measurable improvements in water quality.

However, the data showed small but measurable improvements in nitrogen and sediment across most monitoring sites. Rivers with improved long-term water quality include the Herbert, Burdekin and Pioneer rivers, as well as the Tully and Fitzroy.

Our data show that water quality didn't follow a predictable pattern of steady improvement. Most rivers improved in bursts, often following major shifts in rainfall patterns, cyclones, land use or fertilizer practices.

In 2028, Australia will have to report progress on its water quality plan to UNESCO, which has monitored the Great Barrier Reef since it was listed on the World Heritage List in 1981. Trends in these two pollutants will form part of this response.

To do this, we used data on how much fertilizer had been applied to key farmland cropping areas in these regions between 1910 and 2024.

title.en: Team identifies an evolutionarily conserved enhancer that regulates tendon and ligament development
title.zh: 研究小组发现了一种进化上保守的增强子，可以调节肌腱和韧带的发育

summary.en: A research team has uncovered fundamental molecular mechanisms governing the formation of tendons and ligaments, which are essential for musculoskeletal integration. Understanding these mechanisms could pave the way for the regeneration of tendons, ligaments and their attachment...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A research team has uncovered fundamental molecular mechanisms governing the formation of tendons and ligaments, which are essential for musculoskeletal integration. Understanding these mechanisms could pave the way for the regeneration of tendons, ligaments and their attachment sites, known as entheses, which have limited capacity for functional repair after injury because of their poor vascularization.

The research was published in the journal Development , which also published an interview with the paper's authors.

The international team identified a novel enhancer that controls the tissue-specific expression of Scleraxis (Scx), a key transcription factor for the formation and maturation of tendons, ligaments and entheses. Enhancers are DNA sequences that function as genetic switches, controlling when and where genes are activated. The newly identified Scx enhancer directs Scx gene expression specifically in tendons, ligaments and their attachment sites during development.

Scleraxis, a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor, is also reactivated in adults during tissue repair and adaptation to mechanical loading. Scientists have long known that tendons, ligaments and entheses fail to develop properly when Scx gene function is lost. Entheses are also vulnerable to injury and mechanical stress, leading to pain and functional impairment known as enthesopathy.

For their study, the team used transgenic reporter mice , a powerful tool that allows researchers to visualize when and where DNA sequences activate gene expression in living tissues. Using this approach, the team identified a 5.3 kb downstream Scleraxis enhancer (dSE) that drove robust, stable and faithful reporter activity (fig. 1). Within the dSE, the team further identified a 343 bp conserved Scleraxis enhancer (CSE). Remarkably, this CSE is highly conserved from lobe-finned fishes to tetrapods and is capable of recapitulating Scx gene expression in developing limbs.

Mice lacking the CSE showed a marked reduction in endogenous Scx gene expression during limb development and failed to form the deltoid tuberosity (DT), a prominent bone ridge where the deltoid muscle attaches to the humerus and supports shoulder movement (fig. 2). Thus, precise activation of the CSE during a critical developmental window is essential for proper DT formation (fig. 3).

Despite the early reduction in Scx gene expression, its expression gradually recovered at later stages. The team suggests that this recovery is mediated by additional elements within the dSE. These findings demonstrate that the CSE acts as a key enhancer...

title.en: The crisis in cosmology continues: Critical problems in a recent defense of cosmic acceleration
title.zh: 宇宙学危机仍在继续：最近宇宙加速辩护中的关键问题

summary.en: Doubts about the standard model of cosmology are deepening after a new study identified fundamental problems in a recent analysis that defended the conventional view that the universe is currently undergoing accelerated expansion driven by dark energy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Doubts about the standard model of cosmology are deepening after a new study identified fundamental problems in a recent analysis that defended the conventional view that the universe is currently undergoing accelerated expansion driven by dark energy.

Last November , researchers at Yonsei University in South Korea reported that, once a systematic bias related to the ages of Type Ia supernovae is taken into account, the universe may no longer be accelerating as previously thought. Instead, their analysis suggested that cosmic expansion has already entered a decelerating phase and that dark energy may not be a cosmological constant but rather a rapidly evolving component that is weakening with time.

The result attracted considerable attention because it closely agreed with the prediction from an independent cosmological probe: the baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO)-only measurements from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI).

In June , an international team led by researchers at the University of Southampton and including two Nobel laureates published a rebuttal challenging the Yonsei result. Their analysis found a much shallower relationship between supernova luminosity and age than that reported by the Yonsei team. They also argued that the ages of supernova progenitors may evolve much less with redshift than the ages of their host galaxies.

On this basis, the Southampton–led team concluded that the required age-bias correction would be small and that the expansion of the universe is still accelerating. The emerging crisis in cosmology therefore appeared to have been averted.

But a new study by the Yonsei researchers, published in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society , finds that both central arguments advanced in the rebuttal are affected by critical analytical problems that undermine its defense of cosmic acceleration.

The first problem concerns the measurement of the "age-bias slope"—the relationship between the standardized luminosities of Type Ia supernovae and their ages.

To measure this relationship reliably, supernovae must be compared within a sufficiently narrow redshift interval. Otherwise, the evolution of the supernova population across the redshift range becomes entangled with the age-luminosity correlation being measured.

The rebuttal study instead combined supernovae over an unusually broad redshift interval. The new analysis demonstrates that this procedure artificially flattens the measured age-bias slope. As progressively higher-redshift supernovae are added to the sample, the recovered slope becomes systematically...

title.en: Reworked tRNAs enable protein design with up to 34 amino acids
title.zh: 改造后的 tRNA 可实现多达 34 个氨基酸的蛋白质设计

summary.en: Scientists have been hard at work for more than 20 years to instruct biological systems, such as E. coli cells, to produce proteins they don't naturally produce. Success could mean faster, cheaper, more innovative solutions for medicine, agriculture, materials science,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists have been hard at work for more than 20 years to instruct biological systems, such as E. coli cells, to produce proteins they don't naturally produce. Success could mean faster, cheaper, more innovative solutions for medicine, agriculture, materials science, environmental remediation and other industries.

The journey so far has been arduous. It seemed that the best—and possibly only—way to achieve the goal was to reprogram an organism's DNA, but that has proven fiendishly difficult and time-consuming and produces feeble results.

The lab of geneticist George Church at Harvard Medical School and the Wyss Institute for Biologically Inspired Engineering at Harvard University has now devised a simpler, faster, safer and larger-scale method to make new proteins without requiring genome recoding or even any organisms.

Their tool, called AGENTEX and published in Nature , allows researchers to design proteins using up to 34 amino acids rather than the 20 naturally occurring amino acids; custom-engineer two types of building blocks (tRNAs and ribosomes) necessary to make those proteins; and insert the building blocks into a standard lab concoction that contains cell components but no actual cells. There, the components churn out the new proteins without interfering with natural protein-making machinery.

"AGENTEX enables researchers to generate entirely new genetic codes on demand in test tubes and use them at scale to build proteins far beyond what nature has evolved," said first author Felix Radford, HMS research fellow in genetics in the Church Lab. "This is more rapid and safe than existing methods, as it does not rely on handling living cells or altering their genomes."

Along the way, the team discovered something unexpected about one of the most fundamental processes of life on Earth: how DNA gets translated into proteins.

"It's been really amazing to be working in this environment because not only are we developing new, innovative technologies but we're also discovering new science at the same time," Radford said.

All natural life is made of proteins, and proteins are built from combinations of just 20 amino acids. Each amino acid is encoded by a triplet of DNA or RNA bases called a codon. But there are about three times as many codons as amino acids. For instance, UCU, UCC, UCA and UCG all code for serine. This redundancy suggests that many codons could be reprogrammed to make something else.

After nine years of effort, the Church Lab demonstrated in 2013 that this could be done, freeing up one codon in E. coli bacteria so the microbes could make whatever...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 二十多年来，科学家们一直在努力指导大肠杆菌细胞等生物系统生产它们自然不产生的蛋白质。成功可能意味着为医药、农业、材料科学、环境修复和其他行业提供更快、更便宜、更具创新性的解决方案。 迄今为止的旅程是艰辛的。实现这一目标的最佳（也可能是唯一）方法似乎是对有机体的 DNA 进行重新编程，但事实证明，这极其困难且耗时，而且效果微弱。 哈佛医学院遗传学家 George Church 的实验室和哈佛大学 Wyss 生物启发工程研究所现已设计出一种更简单、更快、更安全和更大规模的方法来制造新蛋白质，而不需要基因组重新编码，甚至不需要任何生物体。 他们的工具名为 AGENTEX，发表在 Nature 杂志上，允许研究人员使用多达 34 个氨基酸而不是 20 个天然存在的氨基酸来设计蛋白质；定制设计制造这些蛋白质所需的两种构建模块（tRNA 和核糖体）；并将构建块插入标准实验室混合物中，其中包含细胞成分但不含实际细胞。在那里，这些成分会产生新的蛋白质，而不会干扰天然的蛋白质制造机制。 “AGENTEX 使研究人员能够根据需要在试管中生成全新的遗传密码，并大规模使用它们来构建远远超出自然进化水平的蛋白质，”第一作者、英国皇家医学院教堂实验室遗传学研究员菲利克斯·雷德福德 (Felix Radford) 说。 “这比现有方法更快速、更安全，因为它不依赖于处理活细胞或改变其基因组。” 在此过程中，研究小组发现了关于地球上生命最基本过程之一的一些意想不到的事情：DNA 如何转化为蛋白质。 雷德福德说：“在这样的环境中工作真是太棒了，因为我们不仅在开发新的创新技术，而且同时也在发现新的科学。” 所有自然生命都是由蛋白质组成的，而蛋白质则是由 20 种氨基酸组合而成。每个氨基酸均由称为密码子的 DNA 或 RNA 碱基三联体编码。但密码子的数量大约是氨基酸的三倍。例如，UCU、UCC、UCA和UCG都是丝氨酸的编码。这种冗余表明许多密码子可以被重新编程以产生其他东西。 经过九年的努力，教会实验室在 2013 年证明这是可以做到的，释放大肠杆菌中的一个密码子，这样微生物就可以制造任何东西……
