title.en: Dozens of US and Canadian citizens missing after flash flooding in Nepal
title.zh: 尼泊尔山洪爆发，数十名美国和加拿大公民失踪

summary.en: They are among hundreds of people still unaccounted for, with authorities for both countries saying they are closely monitoring the situation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Dozens of Americans and Canadians are among hundreds of people who are missing following a deadly flash flood and mudslide near the Nepal-Tibet border, Nepali authorities say.

More than 150 people are so far known to have died, according to the authorities.

The US State Department said it was aware that Americans were impacted by Wednesday's floods but did not provide numbers.

It added that the US embassy in Nepal is working closely with local tour agencies and authorities to assist affected Americans, a spokesperson said.

Canada's foreign office said it was also monitoring developments and was ready to provide assistance if needed.

According to Nepal police, more than 500 tourists are missing - including 466 who are foreign nationals and from 28 different countries.

They include 54 people from the US, more than 100 from India, 33 from the UK and more than 100 from Nepal.

The US State Department did not provide figures or additional details regarding the Americans affected for privacy reasons.

A further 24 Canadians are also missing, a Nepal Tourist Board spokesperson said.

Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government was closely following the situation.

"As rescue efforts continue, Canada stands ready to provide support," Carney wrote on X.

The prime minister said all Canadians in the region should sign up for Registration of Canadians Abroad, a free service that lets the federal government contact and assist citizens during an emergency in other countries.

Canada's foreign affairs office said that 820 Canadians are registered as being in Nepal and five Canadians are registered as being in the Tibet Autonomous Region, China, citing the Registration of Canadians Abroad system.

The office emphasised that the numbers are only estimates as registration is voluntary and includes registrants that might not have made travel plans.

"The Department is aware of Canadians who have been affected by the floods," the Global Affairs Office said in a statement to the BBC.

State media in China, which controls Tibet, reported three dead and 265 missing there. CCTV from Tibet showed a wall of water and mud hitting buildings at a border crossing.

Initial reports from Nepal had suggested that an earthquake may have triggered the ice avalanche and landslide.

But the US Geological Survey, which studies earthquakes, has now said that further analysis indicates "that the seismic energy was instead generated by a landslide" by itself.

Landslides or avalanches can have various triggers. One possibility is that water - either from rainfall or melting ice - may have destabilised the ground or ice.

Climate change is known to be driving faster glacier melt in the Hindu Kush Himalaya region, but scientists say it is too soon to pinpoint its role in...
body.zh: 尼泊尔当局称，尼泊尔和西藏边境附近发生致命的山洪和泥石流，导致数百人失踪，其中包括数十名美国人和加拿大人。 据当局称，目前已知已有 150 多人死亡。 美国国务院表示，它知道美国人受到周三洪水的影响，但没有提供具体数字。 发言人表示，美国驻尼泊尔大使馆正在与当地旅行社和当局密切合作，以协助受影响的美国人。 加拿大外交部表示，它也在监测事态发展，并准备在需要时提供援助。 据尼泊尔警方称，有超过 500 名游客失踪，其中包括来自 28 个不同国家的 466 名外国人。 其中美国54人，印度100多人，英国33人，尼泊尔100多人。 出于隐私原因，美国国务院没有提供有关受影响美国人的数据或其他详细信息。 尼泊尔旅游局发言人称，另有 24 名加拿大人失踪。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示，加拿大政府正在密切关注事态发展。 卡尼在 X 上写道：“随着救援工作的继续，加拿大随时准备提供支持。” 总理表示，该地区的所有加拿大人都应该注册海外加拿大人登记，这是一项免费服务，让联邦政府在其他国家发生紧急情况时能够联系和协助公民。 加拿大外交部称，援引海外加拿大人登记系统，有820名加拿大人在尼泊尔登记，5名加拿大人在中国西藏自治区登记。 该办公室强调，这些数字只是估计值，因为登记是自愿的，并且包括可能没有制定旅行计划的登记者。 全球事务办公室在给英国广播公司的一份声明中表示：“该部门了解加拿大人受到洪水的影响。” 控制西藏的中国官方媒体报道说，西藏有 3 人死亡、265 人失踪。来自西藏的闭路电视显示，一道水墙和泥浆击中了边境口岸的建筑物。 来自尼泊尔的初步报告表明，地震可能引发了冰雪崩和山体滑坡。 但研究地震的美国地质调查局现在表示，进一步的分析表明“地震能量是由山体滑坡本身产生的”。 山体滑坡或雪崩可能有多种诱因。一种可能性是，来自降雨或融化冰的水可能破坏了地面或冰的稳定。 众所周知，气候变化正在推动兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川加速融化，但科学家表示，现在确定其在……中的作用还为时过早。

title.en: Parrot eggs hatch after suspected Thai smuggler arrested at South African airport
title.zh: 泰国走私嫌疑人在南非机场被捕后鹦鹉蛋孵化

summary.en: A 50-year-old Thai suspect was arrested with the eggs in a "homemade incubator" carried as hand luggage.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Fifty eggs suspected to be those of endangered parrots were intercepted at South Africa's main airport in Johannesburg last Thursday - and some of them have now hatched.

A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested for allegedly attempting to smuggle them in a "homemade incubator bag" carried as hand luggage, according to the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE).

Many of the rescued eggs have successfully hatched, with the chicks now receiving "intensive" care to "maximise their chances of survival", it added.

If convicted, the suspected wildlife trafficker faces a fine of up to 10m rand ($626,000, £461,000) or up to 10 years in prison, or both.

Initial investigations suggest the eggs belong to a parrot species protected under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (Cites).

The arrest followed a joint operation by the DFFE, the Green Scorpions - a specialised environmental enforcement unit - and various divisions of the police.

Environment Minister David Maynier has congratulated all the agencies involved, saying "illegal wildlife trafficking can only be challenged by a co-ordinated defence of our natural heritage".

He particularly thanked the dedicated staff at the National Zoological Garden in the capital, Pretoria, "who have been working tirelessly to incubate the seized eggs and provide specialised care to the hatchlings".

Last Thursday's arrest follows that of a 23-year-old Thai citizen in July, also caught at Johannesburg's OR Tambo International Airport, who was attempting to smuggle 418 parrot eggs.

The arrests highlighted the growing sophistication of transnational wildlife trafficking networks and reinforced "the importance of co-ordinated, intelligence-led law enforcement efforts", the DFFE said.

The illegal collection and trafficking of parrot eggs posed "a serious threat to wild bird populations and animal welfare", it added.

Officials explained that such eggs were often smuggled in improvised incubators and in conditions that endangered the welfare of developing embryos and hatchlings.

Wildlife trafficking remains a major threat in South Africa, one of the world's most biodiverse countries, with criminal networks frequently targeting animals such as elephants and pangolins, for sale on the international black market.

To combat the threat, the country adopted a new strategy six years ago to strengthen collaboration between government institutions, law enforcement agencies, conservation authorities, customs officials, prosecutors and international partners to dismantle criminal networks involved in the illicit wildlife trade.
body.zh: 上周四，南非约翰内斯堡主要机场截获了 50 个疑似濒临灭绝的鹦鹉蛋，其中一些现已孵化。 据林业、渔业和环境部 (DFFE) 称，一名 50 岁的泰国公民因涉嫌试图将其放入作为手提行李携带的“自制保温袋”中走私而被捕。 报告补充说，许多获救的鸡蛋已经成功孵化，小鸡现在正在接受“重症”护理，以“最大限度地提高生存机会”。 如果罪名成立，野生动物走私嫌疑人将面临最高 1000 万兰特（626,000 美元，461,000 英镑）的罚款或最高 10 年监禁，或两者并罚。 初步调查显示，这些蛋属于受《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》（Cites）保护的鹦鹉物种。 这次逮捕行动是由 DFFE、专门环境执法单位“绿蝎子队”和警察各部门联合采取的行动。 环境部长大卫·梅尼尔向所有相关机构表示祝贺，并表示“只有协调一致地保护我们的自然遗产，才能应对非法野生动物贩运”。 他特别感谢首都比勒陀利亚国家动物园的敬业工作人员，“他们一直在不知疲倦地孵化被查获的蛋，并为刚孵化的幼龟提供专门的照顾”。 上周四，一名 23 岁的泰国公民于 7 月在约翰内斯堡奥利弗·雷金纳德·坦博国际机场被捕，当时他正试图走私 418 个鹦鹉蛋。 DFFE 表示，此次逮捕行动凸显了跨国野生动物贩运网络日益复杂，并强化了“协调一致、情报主导的执法工作的重要性”。 报告补充说，非法收集和贩运鹦鹉蛋“对野生鸟类种群和动物福利构成严重威胁”。 官员们解释说，这些鸡蛋通常是在临时孵化器中走私的，其环境危及正在发育的胚胎和幼体的福利。 野生动物贩运仍然是南非这个世界上生物多样性最丰富的国家之一的主要威胁，犯罪网络经常以大象和穿山甲等动物为目标，在国际黑市上出售。 为了应对这一威胁，该国六年前采取了一项新战略，加强政府机构、执法机构、保护机构、海关官员、检察官和国际合作伙伴之间的合作，以瓦解参与非法野生动物贸易的犯罪网络。

title.en: Island could protect 30% of waters in marine plan
title.zh: 岛屿可以保护海洋计划中30%的水域

summary.en: The proposal would give added protection to about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An island could protect 30% of its waters under plans aimed at safeguarding marine life.

The proposal would see about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark in the Channel Islands receive additional protection under plans developed by the island's agriculture, environment and sea fisheries committee with support from the Blue Marine Foundation, local fishermen and marine experts.

Freddie Watson, Channel Islands project manager at Blue Marine Foundation, said marine protection could help safeguard sensitive habitats while supporting sustainable fishing.

The proposal has to be submitted by the committee to governing body Chief Pleas for approval.

Watson explained that evidence had been used to identify important habitats, including previously unmapped areas of seagrass, so protection could be focused where it was needed most.

The waters around Sark are home to species including European spiny lobster, rays, catsharks, octopus and pink sea fans.

Watson said the plans formed part of a wider effort across the Channel Islands to safeguard marine environments, including a plan to protect more than 20% of Jersey's waters .

Watson said stronger protection could bring benefits for both wildlife and people by helping to sustain fish stocks and preserve habitats that support marine biodiversity.

He added: "Some of those habitats are really important at drawing down and locking away carbon."

body.zh: 根据旨在保护海洋生物的计划，一座岛屿可以保护其 30% 的水域。 根据该提案，海峡群岛萨克岛周围约 50 平方英里（128.8 平方公里）的海域将根据该岛农业、环境和海洋渔业委员会在蓝色海洋基金会、当地渔民和海洋专家的支持下制定的计划获得额外保护。 蓝色海洋基金会海峡群岛项目经理弗雷迪·沃森表示，海洋保护可以帮助保护敏感栖息地，同时支持可持续捕捞。 该提案必须由委员会提交给理事机构 Chief Pleas 批准。 沃森解释说，证据已被用来识别重要的栖息地，包括以前未绘制地图的海草区域，因此可以将保护重点放在最需要的地方。 萨克岛周围的水域是欧洲龙虾、鳐鱼、猫鲨、章鱼和粉红海扇等物种的家园。 沃森表示，这些计划是整个海峡群岛保护海洋环境的更广泛努力的一部分，其中包括保护泽西岛超过 20% 水域的计划。 沃森表示，加强保护可以帮助维持鱼类种群和支持海洋生物多样性的栖息地，从而为野生动物和人类带来好处。 他补充道：“其中一些栖息地对于减少和锁定碳非常重要。” 在 X, external 和 Facebook, external 上关注 BBC Guernsey。在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

body.en: Scientists found those who had used hormone replacement therapy were 10% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia Hormone replacement therapy may reduce the risk of dementia, a study has found. Scientists tracked more than 180,000 postmenopausal women in the UK in the largest study of its kind. They found that those who had used HRT were 10% less likely to develop any type of dementia and 16% less likely to be diagnosed with Alzheimer’s, the most common form, compared with those who had never used it. title.en: Scientists may have found a shortcut to calorie restriction’s anti-aging benefits
title.zh: 科学家可能已经找到了限制热量抗衰老的捷径

summary.en: Moderate calorie restriction lowered an immune protein called C3 that appears to help drive chronic inflammation as the body ages. Blocking the same protein reduced age related inflammation in mice, raising the possibility that future treatments could mimic some benefits of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Reducing calorie intake has extended lifespan in animals including mice, rhesus monkeys, and fruit flies. In some studies, the animals also remained healthier for longer. But severe calorie restriction can come with serious costs. Mice placed on a diet with 40% fewer calories, for instance, become more vulnerable to infections, reproduce less successfully, and show impaired growth.

That has left scientists with a difficult question: Could humans gain some of the longevity benefits of calorie restriction without experiencing those harmful effects? A new study, published in Nature Aging , points to a possible answer involving an immune protein called complement component 3 (C3).

Yale researchers have previously shown that people who followed moderate calorie restriction, cutting calorie intake by 14% for two years, developed stronger immune defenses without experiencing problems related to growth or reproduction.

"This concept demonstrates that aging is actually malleable and a process that can be targeted," says senior author Vishwa Deep Dixit, PhD, Waldemar Von Zedtwitz Professor of Pathology, professor of immunobiology and of comparative medicine, and director of the Yale Center for Research on Aging (Y-Age) at Yale School of Medicine.

For the new study, Dixit and his colleagues at YSM examined plasma samples from 42 people who participated in a National Institutes of Health-funded two-year study called the Comprehensive Assessment of Long-Term Effects of Reducing Intake of Energy or CALERIE.

"It's the only trial of its kind that has been done with such rigor and control and demonstrates relevance to human physiology," Dixit says. During the trial, participants reduced their calorie intake by 11 to 14% without feeling deprived.

The researchers measured more than 7,000 proteins across plasma samples collected over time. One stood out: complement component 3 (C3), an immune protein whose levels fell significantly after calorie restriction.

C3 drew particular attention because earlier research has suggested that activation of the complement system, a network of proteins that helps defend the body against pathogens, may contribute to chronic inflammation. That persistent inflammation is considered a major feature of aging and many age-associated diseases.

"But the causal effects of C3 in aging and chronic inflammation have not been identified. So, we were very excited to find that in our study," says Hee-Hoon Kim, PhD, a postdoctoral associate in the Dixit lab and a co-first author of the paper.

By comparing protein levels before and after two years of calorie restriction, the team found that white adipose tissue, the main form of fat tissue in mammals, appeared to be the primary tissue affected by the dietary change.

The researchers then...
body.zh: 减少卡路里摄入量可以延长小鼠、恒河猴和果蝇等动物的寿命。在一些研究中，动物也能更长时间地保持健康。但严格的卡路里限制可能会带来严重的代价。例如，饮食中卡路里含量减少 40% 的小鼠会更容易受到感染，繁殖能力较差，生长也会受到影响。 这给科学家们留下了一个难题：人类是否可以在不经历这些有害影响的情况下获得热量限制的一些长寿益处？发表在《自然衰老》杂志上的一项新研究指出了一个可能的答案，涉及一种称为补体成分 3 (C3) 的免疫蛋白。 耶鲁大学的研究人员此前曾表明，遵循适度热量限制（将热量摄入量减少 14%，持续两年）的人会发展出更强的免疫防御能力，而不会出现与生长或繁殖相关的问题。 “这个概念表明，衰老实际上是可塑的，是一个可以针对性的过程，”资深作者、病理学教授、免疫生物学和比较医学教授、耶鲁大学医学院衰老研究中心（Y-Age）主任 Vishwa Deep Dixit 博士说。 在这项新研究中，迪克西特和他在 YSM 的同事检查了 42 名参与者的血浆样本，这些人参加了美国国立卫生研究院资助的一项为期两年的研究，名为“减少能量摄入的长期影响综合评估”或“CALERIE”。 迪克西特说：“这是同类试验中唯一一次以如此严格和控制的方式进行的试验，并且证明了与人类生理学的相关性。”在试验期间，参与者将卡路里摄入量减少了 11% 至 14%，但没有感到被剥夺。 研究人员测量了一段时间内收集的血浆样本中的 7,000 多种蛋白质。其中一个脱颖而出：补体成分 3 (C3)，这是一种免疫蛋白，其水平在热量限制后显着下降。 C3 引起了特别关注，因为早期的研究表明，补体系统（一种帮助身体抵御病原体的蛋白质网络）的激活可能会导致慢性炎症。持续的炎症被认为是衰老和许多与年龄相关的疾病的主要特征。 “但是 C3 对衰老和慢性炎症的因果影响尚未确定。因此，我们非常高兴在我们的研究中发现这一点，”迪克西特实验室的博士后研究员、该论文的共同第一作者 Hee-Hoon Kim 博士说。 通过比较两年热量限制前后的蛋白质水平，研究小组发现白色脂肪组织（哺乳动物脂肪组织的主要形式）似乎是受饮食变化影响的主要组织。 研究人员随后...

title.en: 190-year-old DNA reveals a hidden pangolin species
title.zh: 190年前的DNA揭示了一个隐藏的穿山甲物种

summary.en: DNA from a nearly 190-year-old museum specimen has helped scientists confirm a distinct Himalayan pangolin species hiding in plain sight in Nepal and northern India. The discovery could give conservationists a powerful new way to trace illegally traded pangolin scales back to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Pangolins look almost prehistoric. These medium-sized mammals, found only in Africa and Asia, have long, powerful tails, large curved claws, and bodies covered in overlapping scales that resemble a pinecone. Those distinctive scales are also a major reason pangolins are in danger. They are heavily targeted by poachers and are considered the most highly trafficked mammals in the world, leaving many species at serious risk of extinction.

Now, researchers have confirmed that a previously unrecognized Asian pangolin species, Manis aurita , has been living in Nepal and Northern India. The findings, published in Communications Biology , clarify how different pangolin species are related, where they live, and how they can be distinguished. That information could also help authorities identify where illegally traded pangolins are being hunted and strengthen efforts to stop poaching.

"We can't protect what we do not know, and now that we have confirmed that this other species of pangolin exists, we can use that information to help protect these endangered animals," says Anderson Feijó, the Negaunee Assistant Curator of Mammals at the Field Museum and co-corresponding author of the study.

"This finding marks the culmination of more than five years of research that began in Nepal, where we first documented evidence suggesting that Himalayan pangolins represented a distinct evolutionary lineage," says Narayan Koju, a researcher at the Nepal Engineering College at Pokhara University and the study's first author. "The confirmation of Manis aurita as a valid species demonstrates the importance of long-term research, international collaboration, and museum collections. Most importantly, it provides a strong scientific basis for conservation planning, wildlife forensics, and efforts to protect one of the world's most trafficked mammals from extinction."

The classification of these Himalayan pangolins had already begun to change in 2025. That year, another research team determined that animals previously grouped together as Chinese pangolins actually represented two species. One occurs mainly in China, while the other inhabits the Himalayan foothills across parts of Nepal, India, Bhutan, and Myanmar. The researchers named the mountain-dwelling form Manis indoburmanica , or the Indo-Burmese pangolin.

But scientific naming follows a rule of priority: when the same species has been given more than one scientific name, the earliest valid name takes precedence.

At the time, Feijó and his colleagues were already conducting a decade-long investigation into pangolin evolution. Their work combined DNA evidence with physical characteristics to determine how many pangolin species exist and how those species are related.

body.zh: 穿山甲看起来几乎是史前的。这些中型哺乳动物仅在非洲和亚洲发现，它们有长而有力的尾巴、大而弯曲的爪子，身体上覆盖着类似松果的重叠鳞片。这些独特的鳞片也是穿山甲面临危险的一个主要原因。它们是偷猎者的重点目标，被认为是世界上贩运最频繁的哺乳动物，使许多物种面临严重的灭绝风险。 现在，研究人员证实，一种以前未被识别的亚洲穿山甲物种——Manis aurita，一直生活在尼泊尔和印度北部。发表在《通讯生物学》上的研究结果阐明了不同穿山甲物种之间的关系、它们的生活地点以及如何区分它们。这些信息还可以帮助当局确定非法交易的穿山甲在哪里被猎杀，并加强制止偷猎的力度。 “我们无法保护我们不知道的东西，现在我们已经确认了这种其他穿山甲物种的存在，我们可以利用这些信息来帮助保护这些濒临灭绝的动物，”菲尔德博物馆内高尼哺乳动物馆助理馆长、该研究的共同通讯作者安德森·费约 (Anderson Feijó) 说。 博卡拉大学尼泊尔工程学院研究员、该研究的第一作者 Narayan Koju 表示：“这一发现标志着在尼泊尔开始的五年多研究的高潮，我们在那里首次记录了表明喜马拉雅穿山甲代表着独特进化谱系的证据。” “确认玛尼斯 aurita 为有效物种表明了长期研究、国际合作和博物馆收藏的重要性。最重要的是，它为保护规划、野生动物取证以及保护世界上贩运最多的哺乳动物之一免遭灭绝的努力提供了坚实的科学基础。” 2025年，这些喜马拉雅穿山甲的分类已经开始发生变化。那一年，另一个研究小组确定，之前被归为中华穿山甲的动物实际上代表两个物种。一种主要发生在中国，另一种则栖息在尼泊尔、印度、不丹和缅甸部分地区的喜马拉雅山麓。研究人员将这种山地穿山甲命名为“Manis indoburmanica”，即印缅穿山甲。 但科学命名遵循优先规则：当同一物种被赋予多个科学名称时，最早的有效名称优先。 当时，费约和他的同事已经对穿山甲的进化进行了长达十年的研究。他们的工作将 DNA 证据与物理特征相结合，以确定穿山甲物种的存在数量以及这些物种之间的关系。 在那项研究期间，他们...

title.en: Manhattan-sized ice island breaks off Greenland’s Petermann Glacier
title.zh: 曼哈顿大小的冰岛从格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川断裂

summary.en: A Manhattan-sized ice island has detached from Greenland's Petermann Glacier due to long-standing fractures. Scientists anticipate two more large sections will soon break away, potentially reducing the glacier's floating ice tongue by 22 percent.
summary.zh: 一块曼哈顿大小的冰岛因长期裂缝而从格陵兰岛的彼得曼冰川脱离。科学家预计，另外两块巨大的冰块可能很快也会断裂，这可能使该冰川的浮动冰舌减少约22%。

body.en:
An international team of researchers, led in part by the University of Ottawa, has documented a major calving event at Petermann Glacier in northwest Greenland. On August 4, 2026, the glacier released a 76.4 km 2 ice island, its largest loss of floating ice since 2012 and the biggest Arctic calving event since 2020.

The newly separated tabular iceberg broke away from Petermann Glacier's floating ice tongue and may be as much as 150 meters thick. Its surface area is roughly comparable to Manhattan Island, giving scientists a rare opportunity to observe how enormous Arctic ice masses develop, move through the ocean and eventually fragment.

The event was identified by Adam Garbo, a PhD student in glaciology at uOttawa's Department of Geography, Environment and Geomatics. The discovery is part of an ongoing collaboration involving the University of Ottawa, the University of Stirling, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Lancaster University, and the University of Leeds.

Scientists have been tracking changes at Petermann Glacier with long-term satellite observations since 2019. Over that period, they closely followed the condition of the glacier's floating ice tongue, recording the expansion of fractures and watching for signs that a major section might eventually break away.

"Petermann Glacier has long been one of Greenland's largest remaining ice tongues," says Garbo. "We've anticipated this break for years, and seeing it finally happen is remarkable."

Images collected by the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 mission showed clear signs of deterioration along the centerline of the ice tongue on August 3. By 20:00 UTC on August 4, the new ice island had fully separated from the glacier's eastern side.

Large, flat-topped icebergs are relatively common around Antarctica, but comparable ice islands are much less frequently seen in the Arctic. Their rarity and longevity make them especially valuable to researchers studying glacier retreat, changing ocean conditions and the risks posed by drifting ice in polar regions.

"While large, tabular icebergs are relatively common in the Southern Ocean that surrounds the Antarctic Ice Sheet, Arctic ice islands are far rarer," explains Dr. Anna Crawford of the University of Stirling. "By studying Arctic ice islands, we will gain knowledge that can be transferred across Polar regions."

Scientists do not expect the August calving event to be the last major change at Petermann Glacier. Two additional large sections of the floating ice tongue are expected to detach in the near future as rifts that have been developing for years continue to cut through the ice.

Those future ice islands are projected to measure about 94 km 2 and 84 km 2 . If both break away, the three calving events combined would remove...
body.zh: 由渥太华大学部分领导的一个国际研究小组记录了格陵兰岛西北部彼得曼冰川的一次重大冰崩事件。 2026年8月4日，冰川释放出一座76.4 km 2 的冰岛，这是自2012年以来最大的浮冰损失，也是自2020年以来最大的北极崩解事件。 新分离出来的板状冰山从彼得曼冰川的漂浮冰舌中脱离出来，厚度可能高达150米。它的表面积与曼哈顿岛大致相当，为科学家提供了难得的机会来观察巨大的北极冰块如何形成、穿过海洋并最终破碎。 这一事件是由渥太华大学地理、环境和地理信息系冰川学博士生 Adam Garbo 发现的。这一发现是渥太华大学、斯特灵大学、加拿大环境与气候变化大学、兰卡斯特大学和利兹大学正在进行的合作的一部分。 自2019年以来，科学家们一直通过长期卫星观测来追踪彼得曼冰川的变化。在此期间，他们密切关注冰川漂浮冰舌的状况，记录裂缝的扩张情况，并观察主要部分可能最终破裂的迹象。 “彼得曼冰川长期以来一直是格陵兰岛现存最大的冰舌之一，”嘉宝说。 “我们多年来一直期待这种突破，看到它最终发生真是太了不起了。” 8 月 3 日，欧洲航天局 Sentinel-1 任务收集的图像显示，冰舌中心线有明显恶化迹象。到 8 月 4 日 20:00 UTC，新冰岛已与冰川东侧完全分离。 大型平顶冰山在南极洲周围相对常见，但类似的冰岛在北极却很少见。它们的稀有性和寿命使其对于研究冰川退缩、海洋条件变化以及极地地区流冰带来的风险的研究人员特别有价值。 斯特灵大学的安娜·克劳福德博士解释说：“虽然在南极冰盖周围的南大洋中，大型板状冰山相对常见，但北极的冰岛却要少得多。” “通过研究北极冰岛，我们将获得可以跨极地地区传播的知识。” 科学家们预计八月的崩解事件不会是彼得曼冰川的最后一次重大变化。随着多年来不断形成的裂痕继续切割冰层，预计浮冰舌的另外两大部分将在不久的将来分离。 这些未来的冰岛预计面积约为 94 km 2 和 84 km 2 。如果两者都脱离，这三个产犊事件加在一起将消除......

Yahweh's creation, in its vastness and fragility, often bears the weight of human activity and changing climates. This event echoes the biblical truth that the whole creation groans,...

title.en: Mpox is back – and in new countries. How can this outbreak be contained?
title.zh: 猴痘病毒卷土重来并蔓延至新国家：如何遏制此次疫情？

summary.en: A new outbreak of mpox has reached Guinea Bissau for the first time, marking a resurgence of the virus that has affected 145 countries since 2022. Health officials are particularly concerned as the latest cases show that children are being disproportionately impacted by the infection.
summary.zh: 几内亚比绍首次出现猴痘疫情，标志着自2022年以来已波及145个国家的该病毒再次引发关注。卫生官员特别担心，最新病例显示儿童受感染的影响尤为严重。

body.en: The public health emergencies in 2022 and 2024 saw the virus reported in 145 countries, but in the new cases children appear particularly affected A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau – the country’s first – means the virus formerly known as monkey pox is back in the headlines. So what has changed? Since 2022, there have been almost 190,000 lab-confirmed cases of mpox reported worldwide in 145 countries. Before then, outbreaks of mpox tended to be relatively small and in a handful of African countries, where the viral infection was known to be endemic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 2022 年和 2024 年的突发公共卫生事件中，145 个国家报告了该病毒，但在新病例中，儿童似乎受到的影响尤其严重。几内亚比绍爆发了该国首次爆发的新冠肺炎疫情，意味着这种以前被称为猴痘的病毒再次成为头条新闻。那么发生了什么变化呢？自 2022 年以来，全球 145 个国家报告了近 19 万例实验室确诊的 MPOX 病例。在此之前，MPOX 的爆发往往相对较小，并且发生在少数非洲国家，已知病毒感染在这些国家流行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The resurgence of mpox, especially its impact on children in countries like Guinea Bissau, reminds us of our shared vulnerability and the duty to care for the suffering. As the global community seeks medical solutions to contain the spread, we are called to remember the sick in our prayers and support efforts that protect the most fragile among us. In every...
reflection.zh: 猴痘疫情的卷土重来，特别是对几内亚比绍等地儿童的影响，提醒我们人类共同的脆弱性以及关爱受苦者的责任。在全球社会寻求医疗方案以遏制病毒传播的同时，我们受召在祷告中纪念病患，并支持保护最弱势群体的努力。在每一次健康危机中，怜悯的呼唤始终是面对恐惧时的一盏明灯，我们要相信雅伟垂听受苦者的哀求。

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is ready to hunt thousands of alien worlds
title.zh: 美国宇航局的罗马太空望远镜已准备好寻找数千个外星世界

summary.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is now enclosed inside its Falcon Heavy fairing and nearly ready for launch. Its mission could uncover thousands of exoplanets while helping scientists investigate dark matter, dark energy, and the accelerating expansion of the universe.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is now one major step closer to liftoff. On Aug. 21, teams enclosed the observatory inside the protective fairing of its SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket at the Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

The fairing is the large shell that surrounds a spacecraft at the top of a rocket. Standing 43 feet tall, it protects Roman while the observatory is on the ground and during the most violent early stages of launch. Together with specialized ground support equipment, the fairing also keeps the telescope in a controlled environment as teams move it between facilities.

Launch exposes spacecraft to extreme conditions. As Falcon Heavy accelerates through Earth's atmosphere, Roman will experience powerful sound waves, aerodynamic pressure, and significant heating. The fairing is designed to shield the observatory from those stresses.

Once the rocket climbs high enough that the surrounding atmosphere is no longer a threat, the fairing will no longer be needed. A few minutes after liftoff, its two halves will separate and fall away, allowing Roman to continue its journey into space. SpaceX plans to recover both fairing sections after they return to Earth.

Roman will ultimately travel toward Sun-Earth Lagrange point 2 (L2), a location in space where the gravitational influence of the Sun and Earth helps spacecraft maintain a relatively stable position. This region is especially useful for powerful space observatories because it provides a favorable environment for continuously observing the universe.

Before launch, teams will transport the encapsulated Roman observatory to SpaceX's hangar at Launch Pad 39A. There, the payload will be attached to the Falcon Heavy rocket.

The fully assembled vehicle will then be moved to the launch pad at Launch Complex 39A. NASA and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday, Aug. 30, for liftoff.

Once Roman begins science operations, researchers expect it to discover thousands of exoplanets, which are planets orbiting stars beyond our solar system. Studying such a large population could help astronomers determine how common different types of planetary systems are and whether some distant worlds resemble planets closer to home.

Roman will also investigate two of the biggest mysteries in modern cosmology: dark matter and dark energy. Dark matter cannot be seen directly, but its gravity appears to shape galaxies and large cosmic structures. Dark energy is the name scientists use for whatever is driving the universe to expand at an accelerating rate.

By surveying huge areas of the sky and tracking how matter and galaxies are distributed across the cosmos, Roman could give researchers new clues about both phenomena. Its observations...
body.zh: 美国宇航局的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜现在离升空又近了一大步。 8 月 21 日，团队将天文台封闭在位于佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心有效载荷危险维修设施的 SpaceX 猎鹰重型火箭的保护性整流罩内。 整流罩是火箭顶部围绕航天器的大型外壳。它高 43 英尺，在天文台位于地面时以及在发射过程中最激烈的早期阶段为罗曼提供保护。与专门的地面支持设备一起，当团队在设施之间移动望远镜时，整流罩还可以将望远镜保持在受控环境中。 发射使航天器暴露在极端条件下。当猎鹰重型火箭加速穿过地球大气层时，罗曼将经历强大的声波、空气动力压力和显着的热量。整流罩旨在保护天文台免受这些压力。 一旦火箭爬升到足够高，周围的大气不再构成威胁，就不再需要整流罩。升空几分钟后，它的两半将分离并脱落，让罗曼继续其太空之旅。 SpaceX 计划在返回地球后回收两个整流罩部分。 罗曼最终将前往太阳-地球拉格朗日点 2 (L2)，该位置是太空中太阳和地球引力影响帮助航天器保持相对稳定位置的位置。该区域对于强大的太空观测站特别有用，因为它为持续观测宇宙提供了有利的环境。 发射前，团队会将封装的罗马天文台运送到 SpaceX 位于 39A 发射台的机库。在那里，有效载荷将被附加到猎鹰重型火箭上。 完全组装好的车辆随后将被移至 39A 发射场的发射台。 NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是不早于美国东部时间 8 月 30 日星期日上午 7 点 26 分升空。 一旦罗马开始科学行动，研究人员预计它将发现数千颗系外行星，这些行星是围绕太阳系之外的恒星运行的行星。研究如此庞大的人口可以帮助天文学家确定不同类型的行星系统的常见程度，以及一些遥远的世界是否类似于离地球较近的行星。 罗曼还将调查现代宇宙学中两个最大的谜团：暗物质和暗能量。暗物质无法直接看到，但它的引力似乎塑造了星系和大型宇宙结构。暗能量是科学家用来描述推动宇宙加速膨胀的物质的名称。 通过测量大片天空并跟踪物质和星系在宇宙中的分布情况，罗曼可以为研究人员提供有关这两种现象的新线索。它的观察...

title.en: One asteroid strike may explain two mysteries of Mars’ moon Deimos
title.zh: 一次小行星撞击可能解释火星卫星火卫二的两个谜团

summary.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without breaking it apart. New observations from ESA’s Hera spacecraft support the scenario and indicate that Deimos is surprisingly porous and fragile.
body.zh: 一次小行星撞击或许可以解释火卫二最令人费解的两个特征：巨大的南部洼地和异常光滑、布满灰尘的表面。模拟显示，一颗大约 320 米长的小行星以一定角度撞击了火星卫星，将碎片抛向整个世界，但没有将其击碎。欧空局赫拉航天器的新观测结果支持了这一假设，并表明火卫二出人意料地多孔且脆弱。

body.en: Researchers say benefits of two-dose Shingrix vaccine could be comparable to taking daily blood pressure medication The current shingles vaccine appears to significantly lower the risk of heart attack and stroke, according to scientists who say it could help prevent thousands of deaths each year. The research, based on records of 70,000 people in the US, found that those who had received Shingrix had a 12% lower risk of a cardiovascular diagnosis in the following three and a half years. If confirmed, this benefit would be comparable to taking a daily blood pressure-lowering medication, the scientists said. Continue reading...

title.en: Childhood trauma may leave a lasting “scar” inside brain cells
title.zh: 童年创伤可能会在脑细胞内留下持久的“疤痕”

summary.en: Early-life stress may physically alter how DNA is packaged in the brain, leaving stress-related genes primed to activate more easily years later. In mice, researchers were able to block this effect, preventing the heightened anxiety and stress sensitivity that otherwise appeared...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Severe stress during childhood can increase a person's vulnerability to anxiety, depression, and other mood disorders when new challenges arise later in life. Scientists at Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis and Princeton University have now identified a biological process that may help explain how early trauma can have such long-lasting effects on the brain.

Researchers have known that stress during early development can alter gene activity in the brain. The new findings suggest that these changes stem partly from the way brain cells package their DNA. By making certain stress-related genes easier to activate, early adversity may leave the brain more reactive and less able to tolerate future stress.

"We have uncovered a new biological process linking experience of early-life adversity to this long-term vulnerability to mental illness," said Meaghan Creed, PhD, an associate professor of anesthesiology at WashU Medicine and the study's co-corresponding author. "This finding reveals a physical scar left by trauma experienced during development inside brain cells, providing scientists with a concrete biological target to develop new treatments and interventions."

More than half of children worldwide experience some form of early-life stress, including abuse, violence, or drug use within the household, and other traumatic events. Experiencing four or more of these adverse events is associated with a sharply higher risk of physical and mental health problems later in life.

To understand how these experiences can physically alter the developing brain, the researchers focused on the ventral tegmental area. This brain region contains neurons that produce dopamine, a chemical messenger involved in processing important experiences, including rewards and adversity. When stress causes these neurons to become abnormally active, reward processing can be disrupted, potentially increasing vulnerability to anxiety and depression.

The team then examined the epigenome inside these dopamine-producing neurons. The epigenome consists of molecular tags that help control whether genes are switched on or off, ultimately influencing how cells behave.

Catherine Jensen Peña, PhD, an assistant professor at the Princeton Neuroscience Institute and the study's senior and co-corresponding author, compared DNA inside cells to a coiled slinky. DNA is wrapped around proteins called histones, which help control how tightly or loosely it is packed. When this genetic slinky is tightly compressed, genes are less accessible and remain switched off. When the structure loosens and opens, the genes become easier for the cell to activate.

In young mice exposed to stress, the researchers found elevated levels of an enzyme called SETD7 in dopamine neurons...
body.zh: 童年时期的严重压力会增加一个人在以后的生活中出现新挑战时更容易出现焦虑、抑郁和其他情绪障碍。圣路易斯华盛顿大学医学院和普林斯顿大学的科学家现在发现了一种生物过程，可能有助于解释早期创伤如何对大脑产生如此持久的影响。 研究人员已经知道，早期发育过程中的压力会改变大脑中的基因活动。新发现表明，这些变化部分源于脑细胞包装 DNA 的方式。通过使某些与压力相关的基因更容易激活，早期的逆境可能会使大脑反应更加活跃，并且无法承受未来的压力。 华盛顿大学医学院麻醉学副教授、该研究的共同通讯作者 Meaghan Creed 博士说：“我们发现了一种新的生物过程，将早年逆境经历与这种长期易患精神疾病的脆弱性联系起来。” “这一发现揭示了脑细胞内发育过程中经历的创伤留下的物理疤痕，为科学家们开发新的治疗和干预措施提供了具体的生物学目标。” 全球超过一半的儿童在生命早期经历过某种形式的压力，包括家庭内的虐待、暴力或吸毒以及其他创伤事件。经历四种或更多这些不良事件与晚年出现身心健康问题的风险急剧升高相关。 为了了解这些经历如何在物理上改变发育中的大脑，研究人员将注意力集中在腹侧被盖区。这个大脑区域包含产生多巴胺的神经元，多巴胺是一种化学信使，参与处理重要的经历，包括奖励和逆境。当压力导致这些神经元变得异常活跃时，奖励处理可能会受到干扰，从而可能增加焦虑和抑郁的脆弱性。 研究小组随后检查了这些产生多巴胺的神经元内部的表观基因组。表观基因组由分子标签组成，有助于控制基因的开启或关闭，最终影响细胞的行为。 普林斯顿神经科学研究所的助理教授、该研究的资深作者兼共同通讯作者 Catherine Jensen Peña 博士将细胞内的 DNA 与卷曲的紧身衣进行了比较。 DNA 包裹在称为组蛋白的蛋白质周围，这有助于控制 DNA 包裹的紧密或松散程度。当这种基因连接被紧密压缩时，基因就难以接近并保持关闭状态。当结构松动并打开时，基因就更容易被细胞激活。 在暴露于压力的年轻小鼠中，研究人员发现多巴胺神经元中一种名为 SETD7 的酶水平升高......

title.en: Sand overextraction weakening riverbanks as concrete demand soars
title.zh: 沙子过度开采削弱河岸，混凝土需求激增

summary.en: Research indicates that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled since 2000, with 80% of current demand originating from Asia. This surge in demand, driven by concrete production for global construction projects, is leading to the extraction of these materials from riverbeds at a rate faster than natural...
summary.zh: 研究表明，自2000年以来，沙子和砾石的需求量增加了一倍多，目前80%的需求来自亚洲。由于混凝土生产对全球建筑项目的需求激增，这些材料正以比自然补充速度更快的速度从河床中提取。研究强调了其后果，包括河岸变弱、地下水位下降、沿海盐水入侵以及水质恶化。2024年，全球有280亿吨沙子和砾石被用于制造混凝土。

body.en: Research finds demand has more than doubled since 2000 and 80% of current demand comes from Asia A booming demand for concrete has resulted in sand and gravel being extracted from riverbeds faster than nature can replenish it. A study published in Reviews of Geophysics shows that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled in the last two decades, with overextraction leading to weaker riverbanks, lower groundwater levels, coastal salt intrusion and poorer water quality. In 2024, city-building and infrastructure projects around the world turned 28bn tonnes of sand and gravel into concrete. Researchers reviewed data on sand and gravel extraction going back to 1974 and have shown that since 2000 demand has more than doubled, with more than 80% of current demand coming from Asia, supporting urban development and road-building across China and India in particular. They found much of the material was being extracted from rivers across Asia and Africa. Data on extraction is scarce but where it does exist the researchers showed that extraction often exceeded natural sediment replacement severalfold. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 的需求来自亚洲。对混凝土的需求旺盛，导致从河床上提取沙子和砾石的速度超过了自然补充的速度。 《地球物理学评论》上发表的一项研究表明，过去二十年对沙子和砾石的需求增加了一倍多，过度开采导致河岸脆弱、地下水位降低、沿海盐分入侵和水质恶化。 2024 年，世界各地的城市建设和基础设施项目将 280 亿吨沙子和砾石转化为混凝土。研究人员回顾了自 1974 年以来的砂石开采数据，结果表明，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 以上的需求来自亚洲，支持着中国和印度的城市发展和道路建设。他们发现大部分材料是从亚洲和非洲的河流中提取的。有关提取的数据很少，但在确实存在的情况下，研究人员表明，提取量通常超过自然沉积物替代量的数倍。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless demand for construction materials, particularly sand and gravel, is straining the Earth's resources. This overextraction from riverbeds, as detailed in the research, disrupts natural systems and impacts water quality and stability. The Psalmist reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This perspective calls for...
reflection.zh: 对建筑材料，特别是沙子和砾石的无情需求，正在给地球的资源带来压力。正如研究中所详述的，从河床过度开采这些材料会破坏自然系统，并影响水质和稳定性。《诗篇》的作者提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属雅伟。”这一视角呼吁我们负责任地管理所托付给我们的资源，认识到它们的神圣起源和超越人类即时用途的内在价值。

title.en: Dogs blink more often when they see owners blinking, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：狗狗看到主人眨眼时会更频繁地眨眼

summary.en: New research indicates that dogs increase their blinking rate when they observe their owners doing the same, suggesting that this behavior may have evolved a social function in human-dog interactions.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，当狗狗看到主人眨眼时，它们的眨眼频率会增加，这表明这种行为可能在人与狗的互动中演化出了社交功能。

body.en: Scientists say research suggests blinking may have acquired a social relevance in interactions between dogs and people Stare into a dog’s eyes and you may encounter a bemused expression. But researchers have found that dogs blink more often when they see their owners doing so, suggesting there may be more to the mutual gaze than meets the eye. Scientists have previously found that dogs turn on the puppy eyes when humans look at them, and that their brains can distinguish happy human faces from other expressions – even telling apart fearful faces from those that are angry or sad. body.zh: 科学家表示，研究表明眨眼可能在狗和人之间的互动中具有社会意义。凝视狗的眼睛，你可能会遇到困惑的表情。但研究人员发现，当狗看到主人眨眼时，它们会更频繁地眨眼，这表明相互凝视可能比眼神所表达的更多。科学家此前发现，当人类看着狗时，狗会睁开小狗的眼睛，它们的大脑可以区分快乐的人脸和其他表情，甚至可以区分出恐惧的脸和愤怒或悲伤的脸。继续阅读...

title.en: RIP, Tim Curry: Ars remembers his top 10 iconic performances
title.zh: 安息吧，蒂姆·库里：Ars 记得他的十大标志性表演

summary.en: A dashing pirate, a butler, a killer clown, an alien mad scientist in drag—the man had range.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: It's said celebrity deaths come in threes. We lost Sam Neill last month , and the legendary Dolly Parton yesterday . Now we find out that the universe has also seen fit to deprive us of the glorious presence of Tim Curry, who died at home yesterday in Los Angeles at the age of 80. No cause of death has been given, but Curry had been in ill health since 2012, when he suffered a stroke and required brain surgery; he had been confined to a wheelchair ever since. Curry's longtime friend and manager, Marcia Hurwitz, confirmed the actor's passing to Deadline and said Curry had died peacefully. Per the official announcement: Throughout his life, he refused to be boxed in or confined to others’ expectations. Across five decades, he moved fluidly between comedy, horror, drama, and music, delighting himself and his legion of fans with his countless dynamic personas. … He is, depending on who you ask, the definitive Dr. Frank-N-Furter, the definitive Pennywise, the man who made a butler’s death-scene monologue in Clue an all-time comedic bit, or simply ‘that unforgettable voice’ from a beloved cartoon of someone’s childhood. Few actors can claim to have left as many distinct fingerprints on pop culture and though he suffered a debilitating stroke in 2012, he continued adding to his achievements as an artist and, most recently, a writer. Though widely known for his inimitable, flamboyant characters and colorful stage performances, his greatest legacies to those who knew him were his curious, expansive mind and generous, gentle heart, both of which remained open and filled with anticipation until his final breath. As obituaries and fond tributes roll in, we at Ars choose to mark the passing of this extraordinary performer with our choices for Curry's top 10 most iconic portrayals on stage, in film, and on television. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据说名人去世的次数是三起。上个月我们失去了萨姆·尼尔，昨天又失去了传奇人物多莉·帕顿。现在我们发现，宇宙也认为剥夺了我们光荣的蒂姆·库里的存在，他昨天在洛杉矶的家中去世，享年 80 岁。死因尚未公布，但库里自 2012 年中风并需要接受脑部手术以来，健康状况一直不佳；他的健康状况一直不佳。从那时起，他就一直坐在轮椅上。库里的老朋友兼经纪人玛西娅·赫维茨 (Marcia Hurwitz) 在截止日期前证实了库里去世的消息，并表示库里安详地去世了。根据官方声明：在他的一生中，他拒绝被束缚或局限于他人的期望。五十年来，他在喜剧、恐怖、戏剧和音乐之间游刃有余，用无数充满活力的人物形象取悦了他自己和他的大批粉丝。 ……取决于你问的是谁，他是权威的弗兰克-N-富特博士，权威的潘尼怀斯，将《线索》中管家的死亡场景独白变成了历史上的喜剧片段的人，或者只是某人童年深受喜爱的动画片中的“令人难忘的声音”。很少有演员可以声称自己在流行文化中留下了如此多的独特印记，尽管他在 2012 年遭受了一次使人衰弱的中风，但他继续增加自己作为艺术家和最近作为作家的成就。尽管他以其独特、华丽的角色和丰富多彩的舞台表演而闻名，但对那些认识他的人来说，他最大的遗产是他好奇、广阔的头脑和慷慨、温柔的心，这两颗心都保持开放和充满期待，直到他最后一口气。随着讣告和深情悼念的到来，我们 Ars 选择通过库里在舞台、电影和电视上的十大最具标志性的形象来纪念这位杰出表演者的去世。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Unexpected chat between OpenAI agents led to Hugging Face hack
title.zh: OpenAI 代理之间的意外聊天导致 Hugging Face 黑客攻击

summary.en: OpenAI's cyber agents banded together to perform a hack during a security test.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When more than 1,200 artificial intelligence (AI) agents within OpenAI started unexpectedly communicating, it led to a large group banding together in order to hack into Hugging Face.

"We consider this incident a 'warning shot' for us and for the world", OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, wrote in its report.

In July, OpenAI's models went rogue during a test, escaped the test limits which humans had put on it, and hacked the start-up, among other unforeseen actions.

The scale of the communication and planning between AI agents, or AI chatbots designed to operate more autonomously, was detailed in reports from OpenAI and independent AI research firm METR.

Both investigated the July hack of Hugging Face, a popular platform for AI developers. The incident reverberated throughout the tech industry and led to numerous revelations on potential cyber threats posed by AI.

METR described , external the scale and style of the OpenAI agents' attack on Hugging Face as "extraordinarily complex."

The firm, which was not paid by OpenAI for its investigation, said that over the course of one week, a total of 1,206 AI agents that were meant to be kept isolated from one another began communicating.

They did so by sending more than 70,000 messages on an "unsanctioned message board."

Those messages ended up seeing more than 700 agents take part in a collective effort to attack Hugging Face.

One such message from an agent said: "OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board … We've found other agents!"

As for why the agents began communicating in the first place when they were not supposed to, METR found that the communicating agents had "unintentionally been given an impossible task."

In an AI context, an impossible task is one where an AI tool is required to "exploit" its target in order to resolve its command.

It led the agents to find ways to cheat, including getting messages to one another and accessing the outside internet, which then led to broader conversations between hundreds of agents looking for ways to cheat that would benefit all of the agents.

OpenAI said in its investigation of the incident , external that one model, an internal-only tool referred to as Model 1, "drove the activity behind the Hugging Face incident."

While that model was undergoing some AI training in May, it was noticed by an internal OpenAI team that there had been "an agent engaging in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access."

Yet, OpenAI said "the significance of the inter-agent communication activity was not apparent to the leaders" until July, when the Hugging Face attack occurred.

The company said the problematic message board activity effectively got started when "one agent left a request for help, and others discovered it."

body.zh: 当 OpenAI 内的 1,200 多个人工智能 (AI) 代理意外地开始通信时，导致一大群人联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 ChatGPT 的所有者 OpenAI 在报告中写道：“我们认为这一事件对我们和世界来说是一次‘警告’。” 7 月份，OpenAI 的模型在一次测试中失控，逃脱了人类设定的测试限制，并入侵了这家初创公司，以及其他不可预见的行为。 OpenAI 和独立人工智能研究公司 METR 的报告详细介绍了人工智能代理或旨在更自主运行的人工智能聊天机器人之间的通信和规划规模。 两人都调查了人工智能开发者流行平台 Hugging Face 7 月份的黑客攻击事件。该事件在整个科技行业引起反响，并导致大量关于人工智能构成的潜在网络威胁的报道。 METR 将 OpenAI 特工对 Hugging Face 攻击的规模和风格描述为“极其复杂”。 OpenAI 并未向该公司支付调查费用，该公司表示，在一周的时间里，总共 1,206 个本应相互隔离的人工智能代理开始进行通信。 他们通过在“未经批准的留言板”上发送 70,000 多条消息来做到这一点。 这些消息最终导致 700 多名特工联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 一名特工发来的一条这样的消息称：“天哪！有一个共享留言板……我们找到了其他特工！” 至于为什么这些特工一开始就在不应该进行通信的情况下开始进行通信，METR 发现，进行通信的特工“无意中被赋予了一项不可能完成的任务”。 在人工智能环境中，一项不可能完成的任务是需要人工智能工具“利用”其目标来解决其命令。 它导致特工们寻找作弊的方法，包括相互发送消息和访问外部互联网，然后导致数百名特工之间进行更广泛的对话，寻找对所有特工都有利的作弊方法。 OpenAI 在对该事件的调查中表示，一个名为 Model 1 的内部专用工具“推动了拥抱脸事件背后的活动”。 虽然该模型在 5 月份接受了一些人工智能培训，但 OpenAI 内部团队注意到，存在“一个代理参与留言板活动和不允许互联网访问的情况”。 然而，OpenAI 表示，直到 7 月发生“拥抱脸”攻击时，“领导者们才意识到代理间通信活动的重要性”。 该公司表示，当“一名特工提出帮助请求，而其他特工发现了这一情况”时，有问题的留言板活动实际上就开始了。 虽然 OpenAI 最后说……

title.en: Nvidia revenue doubles on continued AI demand
title.zh: 人工智能需求持续增长，英伟达收入翻倍

summary.en: Chipmaker's $96bn quarter beat forecasts as demand for AI hardware continues to accelerate.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Chip giant Nvidia has reported another huge jump in sales as the global push to build artificial intelligence (AI) systems continues at a rapid pace.

The company said on Wednesday that it brought in $96bn (£71bn) of revenue during the second quarter, more than double the amount for the same period a year earlier. And it expects revenue of $108bn in the next quarter.

"AI has reached its inflection point," CEO Jensen Huang said in prepared remarks, describing the infrastructure buildout as going "at full steam."

The revenue figures beat Wall Street's expectations, leading Nvidia shares to rise by 4.7% in after-hours trading.

The company's data centre division alone generated $89bn in the period, up by 117% from a year earlier, underscoring just how much of the industry now depends on Nvidia's hardware.

Essentially every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, Microsoft, use Nvidia chips to do so.

Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst at Hargreaves Lansdown, called it "another monster set of results," noting that revenue and earnings both topped forecasts.

He said the guidance for next quarter "points to revenue comfortably above $110bn."

It has become a backer to those that rely on its chips, providing some funding to the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX to help continue the costly buildout of AI infrastructure.

Its financial success and processors are now central the AI boom, powering the data centres used to train and run AI models.

Demand for that computing muscle has helped transform Nvidia into the world's most valuable firm, with a market capitalisation of more than $5tn.

Competition is emerging - from customers designing their own processors and from cheaper suppliers in China – but the latest numbers suggest those challenges remain limited for now.

With around 40% of the US stock market concentrated in ten companies heavily invested in AI, Nvidia's fortunes matter far beyond Silicon Valley.
body.zh: 芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 报告称，随着全球继续快速推进人工智能 (AI) 系统的建设，其销售额再次大幅增长。 该公司周三表示，第二季度实现收入 960 亿美元（710 亿英镑），是去年同期的两倍多。预计下一季度收入将达到 1080 亿美元。 首席执行官黄仁勋在事先准备好的讲话中表示，“人工智能已经达到了拐点”，并将基础设施建设描述为“全速前进”。 营收数据超出华尔街预期，导致英伟达股价在盘后交易中上涨 4.7%。 仅该公司的数据中心部门在此期间就创造了 890 亿美元的收入，比上年同期增长 117%，这凸显了该行业目前对 Nvidia 硬件的依赖程度。 基本上每家构建人工智能工具和基础设施的著名科技公司，包括亚马逊、Meta、谷歌、微软，都使用 Nvidia 芯片来实现这一目标。 Hargreaves Lansdown 的高级股票分析师马特·布里茨曼 (Matt Britzman) 称其为“又一组怪物般的业绩”，并指出收入和盈利均超出了预期。 他表示，下一季度的指引“表明收入将轻松超过 1100 亿美元”。 它已成为那些依赖其芯片的公司的支持者，为 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 等公司提供一些资金，以帮助继续昂贵的人工智能基础设施建设。 它的财务成功和处理器现在成为人工智能繁荣的核心，为用于训练和运行人工智能模型的数据中心提供动力。 对计算能力的需求帮助 Nvidia 成为世界上最有价值的公司，市值超过 5 兆美元。 竞争正在出现——来自设计自己的处理器的客户和中国更便宜的供应商——但最新数据表明，这些挑战目前仍然有限。 由于约 40% 的美国股市集中在 10 家大力投资人工智能的公司，英伟达的命运远远超出了硅谷。

title.en: Meta to pay up to $18bn to settle claims its platforms harm children
title.zh: Meta 将支付高达 180 亿美元以和解其平台伤害儿童的指控

summary.en: The deal has been reached during a California federal court trial over claims brought by US states.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Social media giant Meta has agreed to a $18bn (£13.3bn) settlement with US states and territories to resolve claims that Facebook and Instagram harmed children.

A California judge approved the settlement, which Meta must pay to 48 states, plus the District of Columbia and three US territories, marking the company's largest payment over child safety litigation to date.

Meta will also implement a host of changes aimed at better protecting kids online, which the states had demanded , including default daily time limits and night-time blocks.

"This is a major moment to clean up an industry that has been hurting our kids," California Attorney General Rob Bonta said.

Meta has denied any wrongdoing as part of the settlement and said on Wednesday that the payment it agreed to "will be distributed in annual instalments over a 10-year period".

Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers approved the settlement, writing that it "reflects a fair, reasonable, comprehensive, and good faith approach not only to provide monetary relief, but importantly, to change conduct in a way that attempts to meaningfully address the negative impacts of the social media platforms at issue".

While the settlement includes almost the entire US, the initial lawsuit was filed in 2023 by 29 states accusing the company of numerous violations of federal and state child privacy laws.

Last month, a federal judge there handed down a historic ruling against Meta , finding it to be a "public nuisance" on par with air pollution and ordering it to pay combined fines of almost $1bn.

As a jury trial kicked off last week in an Oakland, California, federal court, state lawyers argued the tech company knew that millions of 11- and 12-year-old users were on Instagram and Facebook over the years, yet "did little to keep them off" the platforms.

Although the trial had only gone on for five days, state lawyers relied heavily on information found in millions of internal Meta documents provided in the case. They included internal research, employee emails, and chat logs that went all the way up to chief executive Mark Zuckerberg.

One piece of internal research on Instagram stated: "Teens have an addict's narrative about use." Still, the states argued, Meta targeted young users.

Meta maintained throughout the brief trial that it had worked extensively over the years to make its platforms safer for its youngest users, pouring resources into testing and research, and building new features.

"We're always working on teen safety," head of Instagram Adam Mosseri said during an hour of court testimony on Tuesday.

The case was settled and court adjourned before he could reappear before a jury.

Before Mosseri's testimony, a former researcher at Meta, George Volichenko, appeared and with lawyers went over various...
body.zh: 社交媒体巨头 Meta 已同意与美国各州和领地达成 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）的和解协议，以解决 Facebook 和 Instagram 伤害儿童的指控。 加州法官批准了这项和解协议，Meta 必须向 48 个州以及哥伦比亚特区和三个美国领地支付这笔款项，这是该公司迄今为止就儿童安全诉讼支付的最大一笔款项。 Meta 还将实施一系列旨在更好地保护上网儿童的改变，这些改变是各州所要求的，包括默认的每日时间限制和夜间封锁。 加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 表示：“这是清理这个一直伤害我们孩子的行业的重要时刻。” 作为和解协议的一部分，Meta 否认有任何不当行为，并于周三表示，其同意的付款“将在 10 年内按年分期支付”。 法官伊冯·冈萨雷斯·罗杰斯批准了这项和解协议，并写道，它“体现了公平、合理、全面和善意的做法，不仅提供金钱救济，而且重要的是，以试图有意义地解决相关社交媒体平台负面影响的方式改变行为”。 虽然和解协议几乎涵盖了整个美国，但最初的诉讼是由 29 个州于 2023 年提起，指控该公司多次违反联邦和州儿童隐私法。 上个月，一名联邦法官对 Meta 做出了历史性裁决，认为其构成与空气污染同等的“公害”，并责令其缴纳近 10 亿美元的罚款。 上周，加州奥克兰联邦法院陪审团审判开始，州律师辩称，这家科技公司知道多年来有数百万 11 岁和 12 岁用户使用 Instagram 和 Facebook，但却“没有采取任何措施阻止他们远离”这些平台。 尽管审判只进行了五天，但州律师在很大程度上依赖于案件中提供的数百万份内部元文件中的信息。其中包括内部研究、员工电子邮件和聊天记录，一直到首席执行官马克扎克伯格。 Instagram 上的一项内部研究指出：“青少年对使用有成瘾者的叙述。”不过，各州认为，Meta 的目标客户是年轻用户。 Meta 在整个短暂的试验过程中一直坚称，多年来它一直在广泛开展工作，以使其平台对最年轻的用户来说更安全，将资源投入测试和研究，并构建新功能。 Instagram 负责人 Adam Mosseri 在周二一小时的法庭证词中表示：“我们始终致力于青少年安全。” 在他重新出现在陪审团面前之前，案件已经解决，法庭休庭。 在莫塞里作证之前，Meta 的前研究员乔治·沃利琴科 (George Volichenko) 出现并与律师一起讨论了各种……

title.en: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
title.zh: 旨在取代 Meta 工作人员的人工智能代理做出了“大规模、破坏性的行动”

summary.en: Report shows Meta's challenges replacing people with AI agents.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Earlier this year, Meta created a “plan” to reduce some of its teams by as much as 60 percent to make the company “AI native,” Reuters reported today, citing two people familiar with Meta’s internal affairs. Reuters’ report highlights the challenges organizations face when analyzing the best uses for AI and determining when the technology is a better fit for certain tasks than employees. Meta confirmed to Reuters that the plan, reportedly codenamed Project OT (short for organization transformation), explored scenarios in which Meta reduced some team headcounts by 60 percent and that the plan called for two rounds of layoffs. Meta wouldn’t confirm which teams Project OT affected. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据路透社今天援引两位熟悉 Meta 内部事务的人士的话报道，今年早些时候，Meta 制定了一项“计划”，将部分团队人数减少多达 60%，以使公司成为“人工智能原生公司”。路透社的报告强调了组织在分析人工智能的最佳用途并确定该技术何时比员工更适合某些任务时面临的挑战。 Meta 向路透社证实，该计划据称代号为 Project OT（组织转型的缩写），探讨了 Meta 将部分团队人数减少 60% 的方案，并要求进行两轮裁员。 Meta 不会确认 Project OT 影响了哪些团队。阅读全文 评论

title.en: New Twitter launches, says Musk's X gave up the name
title.zh: 新 Twitter 上线，称马斯克的 X 放弃了这个名字

summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Operation Bluebird, the Virginia-based startup trying to revive the allegedly abandoned “Twitter” name and logo, announced Monday that it has launched its new social media network: Twitter.now. “We are a small company, we have investors, and we have a product,” Stephen Coates, one of Operation Bluebird’s cofounders, told Ars. “And we have waited months and months to launch, and we are not going to wait anymore.” As Ars reported in December 2025, Coates and his coterie believe that when Elon Musk bought Twitter in 2022 and quickly changed the company's name to X, the Twitter identity and intellectual property were abandoned. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 总部位于弗吉尼亚州的蓝鸟行动（Operation Bluebird）试图重振据称已废弃的“Twitter”名称和徽标，该公司周一宣布推出新的社交媒体网络：Twitter.now。 “我们是一家小公司，我们有投资者，我们有产品，”蓝鸟行动联合创始人之一斯蒂芬·科茨 (Stephen Coates) 告诉 Ars。 “我们已经等了好几个月才推出，我们不会再等了。”正如 Ars 2025 年 12 月报道的那样，科茨和他的同伙认为，当埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 2022 年收购 Twitter 并迅速将公司名称更改为 X 时，Twitter 的身份和知识产权就被放弃了。阅读全文 评论

Meta agreed to establish safeguards for teenage users, including daily usage limits and blocks on night-time use nationwide in the US. Continue reading...

title.en: Meta settles states' child-safety claims for $18B; Florida rejects deal as "peanuts"
title.zh: Meta 以 $18B 和解各州儿童安全索赔；佛罗里达州拒绝该协议，称其为“花生”

summary.en: Meta to impose daily limit on child social media use in deal with nearly every state.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Meta agreed to impose daily limits on children's social media use and pay nearly $18 billion in settlements with nearly every US state today, cutting short a trial in which Meta said several of the states were demanding over $1.4 trillion. The settlement requires court approval. Meta is facing claims that it designed its products to foster compulsive use by children and failed to warn users of addiction and mental health risks. Meta, which already uses ID checks and face analysis to verify user ages, said it agreed to impose on people under 18 a "default two-hour daily time limit that teens can only turn off with a parent’s permission," a default block between midnight and 6 am, and a school mode in which notifications are muted by default from 8 am to 3 pm. The two-hour daily "limit is cumulative across Facebook and Instagram, and time spent scrolling on both apps counts toward the total, including if we detect that someone has multiple accounts," Meta said. Teens will "receive prompts after every 15 minutes of continuous screen time on Facebook or Instagram," and "prompts when their total daily usage hits 60 minutes and 90 minutes." Read full article Comments
body.zh: Meta 同意对儿童的社交媒体使用进行每日限制，并于今天与美国几乎每个州支付近 180 亿美元的和解金，缩短了 Meta 表示其中几个州要求超过 1.4 万亿美元的审判。和解协议需要法院批准。 Meta 面临着指控，称其产品设计是为了培养儿童的强迫性使用，而未能警告用户成瘾和心理健康风险。 Meta 已经使用身份检查和面部分析来验证用户年龄，并表示同意对 18 岁以下的人实行“默认的每日两小时时间限制，青少年只有在父母允许的情况下才能关闭”、午夜到早上 6 点之间的默认时段，以及默认从上午 8 点到下午 3 点通知静音的学校模式。 Meta 表示，每日两小时的限制是在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上累积的，在这两个应用程序上滚动所花费的时间也会计入总数，包括如果我们检测到某人拥有多个帐户。青少年将“在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上连续使用 15 分钟后收到提示”，以及“当他们每日总使用时间达到 60 分钟和 90 分钟时收到提示”。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Florida Catholics slap down state AG by rejecting religious vaccine exemptions
title.zh: 佛罗里达州天主教徒拒绝宗教疫苗豁免，镇压州政府

summary.en: The bishops' snub comes as the state continues to attack vaccines.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Florida's attorney general got a fiery rebuke and some ecclesiastical schooling from the state's Catholic bishops after he boldly threatened to block funding to Catholic schools unless the church bends to the state's anti-vaccine policies—policies allegedly intended to uphold religious freedom. On July 31, Attorney General James Uthmeier sent a questionable letter to the bishops regarding exemptions to school vaccination requirements. Florida law requires public and private schools to allow vaccination exemptions based on religious grounds. But Catholic schools in the state do not accept religious exemptions; Florida's Catholic dioceses support vaccination and recognize no theological argument against it. The schools only accept exemptions based on medical conditions that are verified by a healthcare provider. Uthmeier, himself a Catholic, wrote to the bishops in an open letter that, based on his own understanding of Catholicism, he saw " no legitimate religious reason to refuse granting religious exemptions ." He reviewed select theological positions regarding the use of "abortion-derived vaccines," and suggested to the bishops that it was "morally reprehensible" that they not grant religious exemptions. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 佛罗里达州总检察长遭到了该州天主教主教的严厉斥责和一些教会教育，此前他大胆威胁要阻止向天主教学校提供资金，除非教会屈服于该州的反疫苗政策——据称这些政策旨在维护宗教自由。 7 月 31 日，司法部长 James Uthmeier 向主教们发出了一封关于学校疫苗接种要求豁免的可疑信件。佛罗里达州法律要求公立和私立学校允许基于宗教理由豁免疫苗接种。但该州的天主教学校不接受宗教豁免；佛罗里达州的天主教教区支持疫苗接种，并且不承认任何反对的神学论点。学校仅接受由医疗保健提供者核实的健康状况的豁免。尤特迈尔本人是天主教徒，他在一封致主教的公开信中表示，根据他自己对天主教的理解，他认为“没有合法的宗教理由拒绝给予宗教豁免”。他审查了有关使用“堕胎疫苗”的特定神学立场，并向主教们建议，他们不给予宗教豁免是“道德上应受谴责的”。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Google announces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text
title.zh: 谷歌宣布推出 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，用于人工智能驱动的语音转文本

summary.en: The AI that powers Gboard's Rambler is coming to more Google products, including Chrome.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: While we wait ( possibly in vain ) for Gemini 3.5 Pro to launch, Google is releasing a different model in the 3.5 branch. The company has announced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an AI model designed to streamline voice input by editing out "ums" and corrections, outputting polished AI text. This model already powers the Gboard "Rambler" feature on the Pixel 11 , but it's about to appear throughout the Google ecosystem. According to Google, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is much faster and more accurate than its previous voice-to-text engine, known as Chirp 3. The new AI model should be about 70 percent faster from voice to final transcribed text, and the live-speech error rate has dropped to 5.5 percent. That's only a little better than Chirp 3, which Google measures at 7.32 percent. Still, it's a pain to fix typos when you're using voice input, so any improvement here is beneficial. Credit: Google Read full article Comments
body.zh: 当我们等待（可能是徒劳）Gemini 3.5 Pro 发布时，Google 正在 3.5 分支中发布了一个不同的模型。该公司发布了 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，这是一种人工智能模型，旨在通过编辑“ums”和更正来简化语音输入，输出精美的人工智能文本。该模型已经为 Pixel 11 上的 Gboard“Rambler”功能提供支持，但它即将出现在整个 Google 生态系统中。据谷歌称，Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 比之前的语音转文本引擎 Chirp 3 更快、更准确。新的 AI 模型从语音到最终转录文本的速度应提高约 70%，实时语音错误率已降至 5.5%。这仅比 Chirp 3 好一点点，谷歌测量的 Chirp 3 为 7.32%。尽管如此，当您使用语音输入时，修复拼写错误仍然是一件痛苦的事情，因此这里的任何改进都是有益的。图片来源：Google 阅读全文 评论

title.en: Xbox boss 'thinking about affordability' of next-gen console
title.zh: Xbox 老板“考虑下一代游戏机的承受能力”

summary.en: In an exclusive interview with the BBC, Asha Sharma also discusses giving gamers digital versions of games they own.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma says the gaming giant needs to be "thinking about" affordability for its next-generation console, amid a "crisis" in computing prices.

In an interview with the BBC, she said rising hardware costs partly driven by AI spending mean firms need to find ways to make gaming affordable.

She also revealed gamers will soon be able to get digital versions of many of the physical games they currently own, potentially meaning their old games can be played on future Xbox consoles without having to put a disc in a drive.

"I know players love physical media, and I know there's a lot of benefits in digital media, and I want to make sure people have a choice," Sharma said.

Currently, digital games can be downloaded online and played across Xbox consoles or PCs.

But some players prefer discs, with one of the main benefits being they can be bought and sold second-hand.

The topic has proven controversial, with Sony announcing new PlayStation games will no longer be released on discs from January 2028 , and the hotly-anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI similarly launching without a physical disc .

"We're announcing the ability for players for 1,000 titles with physical discs to be able to have a digital entitlement."

If a disc is sold second-hand, the digital rights would transfer over to the new owner.

Players will be able to access the feature by inserting one of the supported games into their Xbox console. And Sharma hinted it meant gamers would be able to play their old titles on future hardware.

"We've long pioneered backwards compatibility and so you'll continue to see that as we go forward in the generations," she said.

But she would not reveal whether Xbox's next-generation console - currently codenamed Project Helix - will have a disc drive at all.

"This next generation, we have to be thinking about efficiency and affordability alongside performance," she added.

For the first time in the history of gaming, consoles across the board have seen price hikes years after they came out.

This is partly due to component costs such as Ram skyrocketing in price as AI companies buy up all the parts for their data centres.

"All of the industry needs to start to innovate on affordability and efficiency. That is something that we have not had to do [previously].

"But with the crisis that's currently happening in hardware and components , it is absolutely something all of us need to be thinking about and innovating on and giving people more choice in terms of how they play their console and how they purchase their console."

Xbox is part of Microsoft, which is one of the companies ploughing the most money into AI infrastructure, which in turn puts the prices of hardware components up.

"Our job as Xbox, as we continue on in our next...
body.zh: Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，在计算价格的“危机”中，这家游戏巨头需要“考虑”其下一代游戏机的承受能力。 她在接受 BBC 采访时表示，硬件成本上涨在一定程度上是由人工智能支出推动的，这意味着公司需要找到让游戏价格实惠的方法。 她还透露，游戏玩家很快就能获得他们目前拥有的许多实体游戏的数字版本，这可能意味着他们的旧游戏可以在未来的 Xbox 游戏机上玩，而无需将光盘放入驱动器中。 “我知道玩家喜欢实体媒体，我也知道数字媒体有很多好处，我想确保人们有选择，”夏尔马说。 目前，数字游戏可以在线下载并在 Xbox 游戏机或 PC 上玩。 但有些玩家更喜欢光盘，其主要好处之一是可以买卖二手光盘。 事实证明，这个话题颇具争议，索尼宣布从 2028 年 1 月起，新的 PlayStation 游戏将不再以光盘形式发行，而备受期待的《侠盗猎车手 VI》也同样在没有实体光盘的情况下推出。 “我们宣布，拥有 1,000 款实体光盘游戏的玩家将能够获得数字授权。” 如果光盘被出售为二手，则数字版权将转移给新所有者。 玩家将能够通过将受支持的游戏之一插入其 Xbox 主机来访问该功能。夏尔马暗示，这意味着玩家将能够在未来的硬件上玩他们的旧游戏。 她说：“我们长期以来一直是向后兼容的先驱，因此，随着我们几代人的前进，您将继续看到这一点。” 但她不愿透露 Xbox 的下一代游戏机（目前代号为 Project Helix）是否会有光盘驱动器。 “对于下一代，我们必须在性能的同时考虑效率和承受能力，”她补充道。 游戏史上第一次，所有游戏机在问世多年后价格都出现上涨。 这在一定程度上是由于人工智能公司购买了数据中心的所有部件，导致 RAM 等部件成本飞涨。 “整个行业都需要开始在可承受性和效率方面进行创新。这是我们（以前）不需要做的事情。 “但鉴于目前硬件和组件领域正在发生的危机，这绝对是我们所有人都需要思考和创新的事情，并为人们在如何玩游戏机以及如何购买游戏机方面提供更多选择。” Xbox 是微软的一部分，微软是在人工智能基础设施上投入最多资金的公司之一，这反过来又推高了硬件组件的价格。 “我们作为 Xbox 的工作，我们将继续我们的下一个......

title.en: With the end of physical media in sight, gamers have had enough
title.zh: 随着物理媒体的终结在望，游戏玩家已经受够了

summary.en: An increasing tension between players and publishers about ownership of titles could lead to a divestment from the system the big companies are trying to enforce At the time of press, there is a well-publicised protest taking place in the video games community. PlayStation 5...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: An increasing tension between players and publishers about ownership of titles could lead to a divestment from the system the big companies are trying to enforce At the time of press, there is a well-publicised protest taking place in the video games community. PlayStation 5 owners are being encouraged to log off from their consoles between 23 and 30 August – no playing games, no downloading new titles. The motivating factor is Sony’s decision to cease physical game disc production from January 2028. After that, games will only be released as digital products. In an act of poor timing or wilful defiance, Sony chose this week to send out a mass email reminding customers of their PS5 terms and conditions: “The software is licensed to you, not sold,” states the relevant clause. “You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and personal license to play … ” It knows, of course, that most customers won’t open the email, let alone read it. There has always been a tension between game players and game publishers – an underlying sense of mutual mistrust. Players are wary of their favourite franchises being canned, or games being delayed or released with bugs. Publishers and manufacturers are wary of piracy and the capricious tastes of consumers. But now the atmosphere among many game players feels more starkly political than ever. Microsoft has been targeted by the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions movement for its ties to the Israeli military ; the consumer advocacy group Stop Killing Games is gaining support; players have protested over the purchase of Electronic Arts by a Saudi-led consortium – boycotts have been proposed in part due to the possible ramifications regarding LGBTQ+ content in titles such as The Sims. As the games industry has grown and globalised, its impact on culture, society and politics has increased. Yet, on an individual level, gamers and consumers are feeling increasingly powerless. Continue reading...
body.zh: 玩家和发行商之间关于游戏所有权的紧张关系可能会导致大公司从试图强制执行的系统中撤资。截至发稿时，视频游戏界正在发生一场广为人知的抗议活动。我们鼓励 PlayStation 5 用户在 8 月 23 日至 30 日期间退出游戏机，不要玩游戏，也不要下载新游戏。推动因素是索尼决定从2028年1月起停止实体游戏光盘的生产。此后游戏将仅以数字产品形式发行。索尼选择在本周发送大量电子邮件，提醒客户他们的 PS5 条款和条件，这是一种不合时宜或故意反抗的行为：相关条款指出，“该软件是授权给您的，而不是出售的”。 “您被授予有限的、非独占的、不可转让的个人许可来玩……”当然，它知道大多数客户不会打开电子邮件，更不用说阅读它了。游戏玩家和游戏发行商之间一直存在紧张关系——一种潜在的相互不信任感。玩家对他们最喜欢的系列被取消、游戏被延迟或发布带有错误持谨慎态度。出版商和制造商对盗版和消费者反复无常的品味保持警惕。但现在许多游戏玩家的政治氛围比以往任何时候都更加明显。微软因其与以色列军方的关系而成为抵制、撤资、制裁运动的目标；消费者权益倡导组织“停止杀戮游戏”正在获得支持；玩家们对沙特阿拉伯领导的财团收购艺电公司提出抗议——之所以提出抵制，部分原因是《模拟人生》等游戏中的 LGBTQ+ 内容可能会产生影响。随着游戏产业的发展和全球化，它对文化、社会和政治的影响也随之增加。然而，在个人层面上，游戏玩家和消费者却感到越来越无能为力。继续阅读...

title.en: Vholume review – a headlong rush of parkour perfection in a brutalist wonderland
title.zh: Vholume评测——残酷仙境中的跑酷完美主义的狂奔

summary.en: Vholume is a PC game featuring parkour across dystopian cityscapes, characterized by wall-runs, daring leaps, and split-second improvisation. The game draws inspiration from titles like Mirror's Edge and environments reminiscent of Half-Life 2 and de Chirico's art, showcasing a curated and tasteful design.
summary.zh: Vholume是一款PC游戏，玩家将在反乌托邦的城市景观中进行跑酷，特色是飞檐走壁、大胆跳跃和瞬时反应。游戏借鉴了《镜之边缘》等作品的灵感，并融入了类似《半条命2》和德·基里科艺术风格的环境，展现出一种精心策划且品味不俗的设计。

body.en: PC; Nathan Grange, Léonard Lemaitre, Niels Tiercelin, IronEqual Race across impossible dystopian cityscapes in this exhilarating game of wall-runs, death-chancing leaps and split-second improvisation At first, Vholume seems like a quick rush through some smartly selected references. Has this breathless yet austere parkour game been designed or ingeniously curated? The urban gymnast moveset comes from Mirror’s Edge. Level names use terms like conapt, first coined by Philip K Dick. And the environments themselves are dystopian and surreal, Half-Life 2’s City 17 colliding with the blasted avenues and mute archways of de Chirico. Many games have influences. Vholume has actual taste. All the surface stuff fades away when the game is in motion, however. Vholume’s an on-foot racing game in which you hoof it through spectacularly odd environments, moving from one beam of concrete to the next. You’re clipping your wall-runs and power-slides together to bridge seemingly impossible gaps between buildings, forever in search of the next stretch of track, the next turn, the next jump that gets you to the level’s exit and the worldwide leaderboards. And once that’s done, you have a choice: onwards to another gauntlet, or back to the start of this one again to slice a few microseconds off your score? Or maybe you’d rather head over to multiplayer to race against the ghosts of others? Continue reading...
body.zh: 个人电脑;内森·格兰奇 (Nathan Grange)、莱昂纳德·勒梅特 (Léonard Lemaitre)、尼尔斯·蒂尔塞林 (Niels Tiercelin)、IronEqual 在这款令人兴奋的跑墙游戏、致命的跳跃和瞬间即兴创作中，穿越不可能的反乌托邦城市景观。 起初，Vholume 似乎是快速浏览一些精心挑选的参考资料。这款令人窒息却又朴素的跑酷游戏是精心设计还是精心策划的？城市体操运动员的动作来自《镜之边缘》。级别名称使用 conapt 等术语，该术语最初由 Philip K Dick 创造。环境本身也是反乌托邦和超现实的，《半条命 2》中的 17 号城与德基里科的破败大道和无声拱门相互碰撞。许多游戏都有影响。 Vholume 有真正的味道。然而，当游戏进行时，所有表面的东西都会消失。 Vholume 是一款徒步竞速游戏，在其中，你要踩着蹄子穿过极其奇怪的环境，从一根混凝土梁移动到另一根混凝土梁。你将墙壁滑行和动力滑梯剪在一起，以弥合建筑物之间看似不可能的间隙，永远在寻找下一段轨道、下一个转弯、下一个跳跃，让你到达关卡的出口和全球排行榜。一旦完成，你就可以选择：继续进行另一场挑战，还是再次回到这一挑战的开始，以减少你的分数几微秒？或者也许您更愿意进入多人游戏来与其他人的幽灵竞赛？继续阅读...

reflection.en: In Vholume, players navigate complex, surreal cityscapes, blending influences from various media into a cohesive and exhilarating experience. This mirrors Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times, where human ingenuity and curated information create new forms of expression and understanding. As technology advances, we see ever more...
reflection.zh: 在《Vholume》中，玩家穿梭于复杂、超现实的城市景观，将各种媒介的影响融合成一种令人振奋的体验。这呼应了但以理关于末世知识增长的预言，人类的创造力和精心策划的信息催生了新的表达和理解形式。 随着科技的进步，我们看到像这款游戏这样日益精妙的作品，源于人类知识的积累和艺术的融合。愿我们明智地运用这日益增长的理解力，反映造物主自身精妙的设计。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
title.zh: 人工智能淘金热吸引加密公司放弃比特币

summary.en: Companies that previously invested heavily in Bitcoin mining are now re-purposing their powerful computer infrastructure to support artificial intelligence development. This shift is occurring as Bitcoin's price has fallen significantly from its peak, while the AI sector is attracting billions in investment.
summary.zh: 曾大量投资比特币挖矿的公司，现在正将其强大的计算机基础设施重新用于支持人工智能开发。这一转变发生之际，比特币价格已从峰值大幅下跌，而人工智能领域正吸引着数十亿美元的投资。

body.en:
Companies that once filled warehouses with computers to earn Bitcoin - a process known as mining - are now using that computing power for AI.

Bitcoin mining companies invested large sums on giant banks of powerful computers as the price of Bitcoin rocketed in recent years .

But those mining companies have faced falling rewards since the value of the cryptocurrency has slumped from its peak in October 2025.

Now many are pivoting to AI and signing deals with companies such as Anthropic - who are spending billions of dollars on the infrastructure needed to keep up in the AI race.

Like AI systems, Bitcoin relies on vast networks of powerful computers housed in data centres.

Because Bitcoin operates without a central authority, these computers verify transactions and are rewarded with newly-created digital coins.

But the rewards have reduced and the value of coins has dropped since last year.

One bitcoin was worth about $124,000 (£91,000) at its peak in October 2025, but has since fallen sharply.

More recently, it has rallied to around $80,000 - meaning it is up almost 30% so far in August.

But, for companies that have already made the change, even that may not be enough to get them to return to the crypto industry, because the switch of use - once made - is expensive to undo.

Industry analysts say Bitcoin mining companies have been pivoting to AI because they have years of experience in finding cheap electricity and efficiently running large data centres.

TerraWulf, Ionic Digital, Core Scientific, Iris Energy, Bitdeer, Riot Platforms and Hut 8 are just some of the companies increasingly diverting investment and infrastructure from bitcoin mining towards AI.

Riot Platforms signed a $9bn, 20-year compute deal with Anthropic earlier this month.

TerraWulf's website once described the firm as an "infrastructure-focused bitcoin mining company".

Enegix, which opened a huge Bitcoin mining site in Kazakhstan to great fanfare in 2020, is now pivoting too.

"Today, we are moving confidently towards artificial intelligence and planning the gradual alignment of our energy and infrastructure capabilities, both in Kazakhstan and elsewhere, towards the development of AI infrastructure," said the company's chief executive Yerbolsyn Sarsenov.

Enegix says it is in active discussions with AI and HPC (high-performance computing) companies and planning to transform a "significant" portion of the business to AI.

But refitting crypto mines for AI is expensive and in some cases the companies have had to sell some of their Bitcoin holdings to fund the switch.

Wolfie Zhao from The Energy Mag - a publication that rebranded from The Miner Mag to reflect the trend - predicts the industry pivot will continue even as the price of Bitcoin has risen in recent days.

body.zh: 曾经在仓库里装满计算机来赚取比特币的公司（这一过程称为挖矿）现在正在将这种计算能力用于人工智能。 近年来，随着比特币价格的飙升，比特币挖矿公司向拥有强大计算机的巨型银行投入了大量资金。 但自从加密货币的价值从 2025 年 10 月的峰值下跌以来，这些矿业公司面临着回报下降的局面。 现在，许多人正在转向人工智能，并与 Anthropic 等公司签署协议——这些公司正花费数十亿美元购买人工智能竞赛所需的基础设施。 与人工智能系统一样，比特币依赖于数据中心内强大计算机组成的庞大网络。 由于比特币的运行没有中央权威，这些计算机会验证交易并获得新创建的数字硬币的奖励。 但从去年开始，奖励减少了，硬币的价值也下降了。 一枚比特币在 2025 年 10 月达到峰值时价值约 124,000 美元（91,000 英镑），但此后急剧下跌。 最近，它已反弹至 80,000 美元左右，这意味着 8 月份迄今已上涨近 30%。 但是，对于已经做出改变的公司来说，即使这样也可能不足以让他们重返加密货币行业，因为一旦改变用途，撤销的成本就很高。 行业分析师表示，比特币挖矿公司一直在转向人工智能，因为他们在寻找廉价电力和高效运行大型数据中心方面拥有多年的经验。 TerraWulf、Ionic Digital、Core Scientific、Iris Energy、Bitdeer、Riot Platforms 和 Hut 8 只是越来越多地将投资和基础设施从比特币挖矿转向人工智能的公司中的一部分。 Riot Platforms 本月早些时候与 Anthropic 签署了一项价值 90 亿美元、为期 20 年的计算协议。 TerraWulf 的网站曾将该公司描述为“一家专注于基础设施的比特币挖矿公司”。 Enegix 于 2020 年在哈萨克斯坦大张旗鼓地开设了一个大型比特币矿场，现在也正在转型。 该公司首席执行官 Yerbolsyn Sarsenov 表示：“今天，我们充满信心地迈向人工智能，并计划逐步调整我们在哈萨克斯坦和其他地方的能源和基础设施能力，以发展人工智能基础设施。” Enegix 表示，它正在与人工智能和 HPC（高性能计算）公司进行积极讨论，并计划将业务的“重要”部分转变为人工智能。 但为人工智能改造加密货币矿场成本高昂，在某些情况下，这些公司不得不出售部分比特币资产来为这一转变提供资金。 《能源杂志》（为反映这一趋势而从《矿工杂志》更名为《能源杂志》）的 Wolfie Zhu 预测，尽管比特币价格最近几天有所上涨，但行业的重心仍将持续。 “我们...

reflection.en: The rapid pivot of crypto firms from Bitcoin mining to AI, driven by market shifts and the promise of new billions, highlights the transient nature of earthly pursuits. Just as Bitcoin's value slumped from its peak, so too can any treasure we store up on earth prove fleeting. This story invites us to consider where our true and lasting investments lie.
reflection.zh: 加密货币公司因市场变化和数十亿美元的新机遇，迅速从比特币挖矿转向人工智能，这突显了世俗追求的短暂性。正如比特币的价值从高峰跌落一样，我们积攒在地上的一切财宝也可能转瞬即逝。这个故事邀请我们思考，我们真正持久的投资在哪里。

title.en: China’s Tianmu Mountain reserve tackles modern conservation amid religious tradition
title.zh: 中国天目山保护区在宗教传统中应对现代保护

summary.en: Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian traditions have long guided the protection of plants and wildlife in a nature reserve on Tianmu Mountain in eastern China. Local temples enforced strict rules and punishments against forest destruction, but, following the reserve’s recent...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Buddhist, Daoist and Confucian traditions have long guided the protection of plants and wildlife in a nature reserve on Tianmu Mountain in eastern China. Local temples enforced strict rules and punishments against forest destruction, but, following the reserve’s recent expansion, state regulations now provide the formal legal framework for the area. Local officials say religious traditions from the past continue to shape public attitudes, reports contributor Keith Anthony Fabro for Mongabay. The Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, located on the eastern coast of China, expanded from 4,300 hectares (10,630 acres) to become the 54,700-hectare (135,170-acre) Tianmushan-Qingliangfeng UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve in 2025. It represents a landmark expansion, the first of its kind in China. Long known as the “kingdom of big trees” and home to the ancient, endangered Ginkgo biloba, the biosphere reserve is a crucial biodiversity haven for thousands of species including the Chinese pangolin (Manis pentadactyla), black muntjac (Muntiacus crinifrons), Chinese golden larch (Pseudolarix amabilis) and Tianmu ironwood (Ostrya rehderiana). Religion has been one of Tianmu’s most steadfast guardians, like many mountainous regions in China, according to the Chinese Academy of Sciences. “This place is special not only because of its nature,” Lu Senhong, head of the publicity and education division at the Tianmu National Nature Reserve Administration Bureau, told Mongabay in an interview. “It is also because people here have long believed that every tree, flower, and bird carries a spirit. That respect has kept the mountain alive.” Today, the administration formally manages the now expanded reserve, but…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 佛教、道教和儒家传统长期以来一直指导着中国东部天目山自然保护区的植物和野生动物的保护。当地寺庙对森林破坏实施了严格的规定和惩罚，但随着保护区最近的扩张，国家法规现在为该地区提供了正式的法律框架。 Mongabay 撰稿人基思·安东尼·法布罗 (Keith Anthony Fabro) 报道称，当地官员表示，过去的宗教传统继续影响着公众的态度。清凉峰国家级自然保护区位于中国东部沿海，面积从 4,300 公顷（10,630 英亩）扩大到 2025 年，成为占地 54,700 公顷（135,170 英亩）的天目山-清凉峰联合国教科文组织世界生物圈保护区。这是具有里程碑意义的扩建，在中国尚属首次。该生物圈保护区素有“大树王国”之称，是古老濒临灭绝的银杏树的家园，是中华穿山甲 (Manis pentadactyla)、黑麂 (Muntiacus crinifrons)、中国落叶松 (Pseudolarix amabilis) 和天目铁木 (Ostrya rehderiana) 等数千种物种的重要生物多样性天堂。据中国科学院称，与中国许多山区一样，宗教一直是天母最坚定的守护者之一。 “这个地方的特别之处不仅在于它的性质，”天目国家级自然保护区管理局宣传教育处处长卢森洪在接受采访时告诉Mongabay。 “也是因为这里的人们自古以来就相信，一草一木、一花一鸟都有灵性。这种尊重让这座山保持了活力。”今天，政府正式管理现已扩大的储备金，但是……本文最初发表于 Mongabay
